_comment: Merged by scripts/build_text_facts.py. A move or ability Champions has is described by Smogon's own Champions dex page (`smogon`) - a move with our crit rate and level added where it leaves them as words. Otherwise, per entry, the text that states more wins - numbers, stages, turns - and a bare 'gives the X status' is penalised. Ties go to Serebii. Every original is kept.

Accelerock.pokebase: The user smashes into the target at high speed. This move always goes first.

Acid Armor.text: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
Acid Armor.serebii: Boosts the user's Defense stat by 2 stages.
Acid Armor.pokebase: The user alters its cellular structure to liquefy itself, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
Acid Armor.smogon: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

Acid Spray.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Acid Spray.serebii: Lowers the target's Sp. Def stat by 2 stages.
Acid Spray.pokebase: The user attacks by spitting fluid that works to melt the target. This also harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
Acid Spray.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

Acrobatics.text: Power doubles if the user has no held item.
Acrobatics.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the user isn't holding an item.
Acrobatics.pokebase: The user nimbly strikes the target. This attack does massive damage if the user isn't holding an item.
Acrobatics.smogon: Power doubles if the user has no held item.

Acupressure.text: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.
Acupressure.serebii: Boosts the Attack Defense Sp. Atk Sp. Def Speed accuracy or evasiveness of the user or an ally by 2 stages.
Acupressure.pokebase: The user applies pressure to stress points, sharply boosting one of its or its allies' stats.
Acupressure.smogon: Raises a random stat by 2 stages as long as the stat is not already at stage 6. The user can choose to use this move on itself or an adjacent ally. Fails if no stat stage can be raised or if used on an ally with a substitute.

Aerial Ace.text: This move does not check accuracy.
Aerial Ace.pokebase: The user confounds the target with speed, then slashes. This attack never misses.
Aerial Ace.smogon: This move does not check accuracy.

After You.text: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.
After You.serebii: Makes the target move immediately after the user.
After You.pokebase: The user helps the target and makes it use its move right after the user.
After You.smogon: The target makes its move immediately after the user this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target would have moved next anyway, or if the target already moved this turn.

Agility.text: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
Agility.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 2 stages.
Agility.pokebase: The user relaxes and lightens its body to move faster. This sharply boosts its Speed stat.
Agility.smogon: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

Air Cutter.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Air Cutter.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Air Cutter.pokebase: The user launches razor-like wind to slash opposing Pokémon. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Air Cutter.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Air Slash.text: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Air Slash.serebii: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.
Air Slash.pokebase: The user attacks with a blade of air that slices even the sky. This may also make the target flinch.
Air Slash.smogon: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Alluring Voice.text: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
Alluring Voice.serebii: Confuses the target if its stats were boosted during the turn this move is used.
Alluring Voice.pokebase: The user attacks the target using its angelic voice. This also confuses the target if its stats have been boosted during the turn.
Alluring Voice.smogon: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

Ally Switch.text: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.
Ally Switch.serebii: The user switches spots with one of its allies. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
Ally Switch.pokebase: The user teleports using a strange power and switches places with one of its allies. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Ally Switch.smogon: The user swaps positions with its ally. Fails if the user is the only Pokemon on its side. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails or if the user's last move used is not Ally Switch.

Amnesia.text: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Amnesia.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Def stat by 2 stages.
Amnesia.pokebase: The user temporarily empties its mind to forget its concerns. This sharply boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
Amnesia.smogon: Raises the user's Special Defense by 2 stages.

Ancient Power.text: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
Ancient Power.serebii: Has a 10% chance of boosting the user's Attack Defense Sp. Atk Sp. Def and Speed stats by 1 stage.
Ancient Power.pokebase: The user attacks with a prehistoric power. This may also boost all the user's stats at once.
Ancient Power.smogon: Has a 10% chance to raise the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

Apple Acid.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Apple Acid.serebii: Lowers the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Apple Acid.pokebase: The user attacks the target with an acidic liquid created from tart apples. This also lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
Apple Acid.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Aqua Cutter.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Aqua Cutter.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Aqua Cutter.pokebase: The user expels pressurized water to cut at the target like a blade. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Aqua Cutter.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Aqua Jet.pokebase: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

Aqua Ring.text: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.
Aqua Ring.serebii: The user gains the Aqua Ring status.
Aqua Ring.pokebase: The user envelops itself in a veil made of water. It regains some HP every turn.
Aqua Ring.smogon: The user has 1/16 of its maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn while it remains active. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will receive the healing effect.

Aqua Step.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Aqua Step.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Aqua Step.pokebase: The user toys with the target and attacks it using light and fluid dance steps. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
Aqua Step.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Aqua Tail.pokebase: The user attacks by swinging its tail as if it were a vicious wave in a raging storm.

Armor Cannon.text: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Armor Cannon.serebii: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.
Armor Cannon.pokebase: The user shoots its own armor out as blazing projectiles. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Armor Cannon.smogon: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Aromatic Mist.text: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
Aromatic Mist.serebii: Boosts an ally's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Aromatic Mist.pokebase: The user boosts the Sp. Def stat of an ally Pokémon by using a mysterious aroma.
Aromatic Mist.smogon: Raises the target's Special Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

Assurance.text: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.
Assurance.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken damage during the turn this move is used.
Assurance.pokebase: This move's power is doubled if the target has already taken some damage in the same turn.
Assurance.smogon: Power doubles if the target has already taken damage this turn, other than direct damage from Belly Drum, confusion, Curse, or Pain Split.

Attract.text: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
Attract.serebii: Gives the target the Infatuated status. This move will fail against a target that is the same gender as the user or whose gender is unknown.
Attract.pokebase: If the target is of the opposite gender to the user, it becomes infatuated with the user and will sometimes be unable to use its moves.
Attract.smogon: Causes the target to become infatuated, making it unable to attack 50% of the time. Fails if both the user and the target are the same gender, if either is genderless, or if the target is already infatuated. The effect ends when either the user or the target is no longer active. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

Aura Sphere.text: This move does not check accuracy.
Aura Sphere.pokebase: The user lets loose a pulse of aura power from deep within its body at the target. This attack never misses.
Aura Sphere.smogon: This move does not check accuracy.

Aura Wheel.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.
Aura Wheel.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage. This move's type depends on Morpeko's form.
Aura Wheel.pokebase: Morpeko attacks and boosts its Speed stat with the energy stored in its cheeks. This move's type changes depending on the user's form.
Aura Wheel.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage. If the user is a Morpeko in Full Belly Mode, this move is Electric type. If the user is a Morpeko in Hangry Mode, this move is Dark type. This move cannot be used successfully unless the user's current form, while considering Transform, is Full Belly or Hangry Mode Morpeko.

Aurora Veil.text: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.
Aurora Veil.serebii: Gives the user's side the Aurora Veil status for 5 turns. This move can be used only in snow.
Aurora Veil.pokebase: This move reduces damage from physical and special moves for five turns. This can be used only when it is snowing.
Aurora Veil.smogon: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical and special attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle; does not reduce damage further with Reflect or Light Screen. Critical hits ignore this protection. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Brick Break and Psychic Fangs remove the effect before damage is calculated. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails unless the weather is Snow.

Avalanche.text: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.
Avalanche.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the target has already dealt damage to the user with a move in the same turn.
Avalanche.pokebase: This move's power is doubled if the target has inflicted damage on the user in the same turn.
Avalanche.smogon: Power doubles if the user was hit by the target this turn.

Axe Kick.text: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.
Axe Kick.serebii: Has a 30% chance of confusing the target. If this move misses or fails the user takes damage equal to 1/2 of its max HP.
Axe Kick.pokebase: The user attacks by kicking up into the air and slamming its heel down upon the target. This may also confuse the target. If it misses, the user takes damage instead.
Axe Kick.smogon: Has a 30% chance to confuse the target. If this attack is not successful, the user loses half of its maximum HP, rounded down, as crash damage. Pokemon with the Magic Guard Ability are unaffected by crash damage.

Baby-Doll Eyes.text: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Baby-Doll Eyes.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Baby-Doll Eyes.pokebase: The user stares at the target with its baby-doll eyes, which lowers the target's Attack stat. This move always goes first.
Baby-Doll Eyes.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Baneful Bunker.text: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
Baneful Bunker.serebii: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. Any attackers that use contact moves against the user during this turn become poisoned. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
Baneful Bunker.pokebase: In addition to protecting the user from attacks, this move also poisons any attacker that makes direct contact.
Baneful Bunker.smogon: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn, and Pokemon making contact with the user become poisoned. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Barb Barrage.text: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.
Barb Barrage.serebii: Has a 50% chance of poisoning the target. This move's power is doubled if the target is poisoned or badly poisoned.
Barb Barrage.pokebase: The user launches countless toxic barbs to inflict damage. This may also poison the target. This move’s power is doubled if the target is already poisoned.
Barb Barrage.smogon: Has a 50% chance to poison the target. Power doubles if the target is already poisoned.

Baton Pass.text: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.
Baton Pass.serebii: The user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon. If the user had any stat changes a substitute or other such effects they will be passed on to the Pokémon switching in.
Baton Pass.pokebase: The user switches places with a party Pokémon in waiting and passes along any stat changes.
Baton Pass.smogon: The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party. The selected Pokemon has the user's stat stage changes transferred to it, as well as the effects of confusion, Aqua Ring, Curse, Dragon Cheer, Embargo, Focus Energy, Gastro Acid, Heal Block, Ingrain, Leech Seed, Lock-On (Mind Reader), Magnet Rise, Perish Song, Power Trick, Telekinesis, and a substitute with its remaining HP. The effect of Gastro Acid is not transferred if the recipient has an Ability that cannot be affected.

Beak Blast.text: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.
Beak Blast.serebii: If the user is hit by a contact move before it uses this move the attacker will be burned.
Beak Blast.pokebase: The user first heats up its beak, and then it attacks the target. Making direct contact with the user while it's heating up its beak results in a burn.
Beak Blast.smogon: If the user is hit by a contact move this turn before it can execute this move, the attacker is burned.

Beat Up.text: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.
Beat Up.serebii: The target is attacked as many times as the number of Pokémon in the user's party. Pokémon that have fainted or have a status condition are not counted. This move's power is calculated based on the Attack stats of the party Pokémon.
Beat Up.pokebase: The user gets all party Pokémon to attack the target. The more party Pokémon, the greater the number of attacks.
Beat Up.smogon: Hits one time for the user and one time for each unfainted Pokemon without a non-volatile status condition in the user's party. The power of each hit is equal to 5+(X/10), where X is each participating Pokemon's base Attack; each hit is considered to come from the user.

Belch.text: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.
Belch.serebii: This move fails unless the user has eaten a Berry during the battle.
Belch.pokebase: The user lets out a damaging belch at the target. The user must eat a held Berry to use this move.
Belch.smogon: Fails unless the user has eaten a Berry, either by eating one that was held, stealing and eating one off another Pokemon with Bug Bite or Pluck, or eating one that was thrown at it with Fling. Consuming a Berry with Natural Gift does not count for the purposes of eating one.

Belly Drum.text: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.
Belly Drum.serebii: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to boost its Attack stat to its sixth stage. This move fails if the user doesn't have enough remaining HP.
Belly Drum.pokebase: The user maximizes its Attack stat but loses HP equal to half its max HP.
Belly Drum.smogon: Raises the user's Attack by 12 stages in exchange for the user losing 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack stat stage is 6.

Bind.text: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
Bind.serebii: Gives the target the Bound status.
Bind.pokebase: A long body, tentacles, or the like are used to bind and squeeze the target for four to five turns.
Bind.smogon: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

Bite.text: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Bite.serebii: Has a 30% chance of making the target flinch.
Bite.pokebase: The target is bitten with viciously sharp fangs. This may also make the target flinch.
Bite.smogon: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Bitter Blade.text: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
Bitter Blade.serebii: The user's HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.
Bitter Blade.pokebase: The user focuses its bitter feelings toward the world of the living into a slashing attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
Bitter Blade.smogon: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

Bitter Malice.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Bitter Malice.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Bitter Malice.pokebase: The user attacks the target with spine-chilling resentment. This also lowers the target’s Attack stat.
Bitter Malice.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Blast Burn.text: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
Blast Burn.serebii: The user gains the Recharging status on the turn after this move is used.
Blast Burn.pokebase: The target is razed by a fiery explosion. The user can't move on the next turn.
Blast Burn.smogon: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

Blaze Kick.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Blaze Kick.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target. This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Blaze Kick.pokebase: The user launches a kick that has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Blaze Kick.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

Blizzard.text: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.
Blizzard.serebii: Has a 10% chance of freezing targets. This move never misses in snow.
Blizzard.pokebase: A howling blizzard is summoned to strike opposing Pokémon. This may also leave the opposing Pokémon frozen.
Blizzard.smogon: Has a 10% chance to freeze the target. If the weather is Snow, this move does not check accuracy.

Block.text: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.
Block.serebii: Gives the target the Can't Escape status.
Block.pokebase: The user blocks the target's way with arms spread wide to prevent the target from fleeing.
Block.smogon: Prevents the target from switching out. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field.

Body Press.text: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.
Body Press.serebii: The damage dealt by this move is calculated using the user's Defense stat instead of its Attack stat.
Body Press.pokebase: The user attacks by slamming its body into the target. The higher the user's Defense stat, the greater the damage this move deals.
Body Press.smogon: Damage is calculated using the user's Defense stat as its Attack, including stat stage changes. Other effects that modify the Attack stat are used as normal.

Body Slam.text: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
Body Slam.serebii: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. If the target has the Minimized status this move's power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.
Body Slam.pokebase: The user attacks by dropping onto the target with its full body weight. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Body Slam.smogon: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

Bone Rush.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Bone Rush.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Bone Rush.pokebase: The user attacks by striking the target with a hard bone. This move hits two to five times in a row.
Bone Rush.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Boomburst.pokebase: The user attacks everything around it with the destructive power of a terrible explosive sound.

Bounce.text: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Bounce.serebii: The user gains the Sky-High status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn. This move has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target.
Bounce.pokebase: The user bounces up high on the first turn, then drops onto the target on the next turn. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Bounce.smogon: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Brave Bird.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Brave Bird.serebii: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Brave Bird.pokebase: The user tucks in its wings and charges at a low altitude. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Brave Bird.smogon: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Breaking Swipe.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Breaking Swipe.serebii: Lowers targets' Attack stats by 1 stage.
Breaking Swipe.pokebase: The user swings its tough tail wildly and attacks opposing Pokémon. This also lowers their Attack stats.
Breaking Swipe.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Brick Break.text: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
Brick Break.serebii: Removes the Light Screen Reflect and Aurora Veil statuses on the target's side.
Brick Break.pokebase: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
Brick Break.smogon: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

Brutal Swing.pokebase: The user swings its body around violently to inflict damage on everything in its vicinity.

Bug Bite.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Bug Bite.serebii: If the target is holding a Berry the user eats that Berry and gains its effect.
Bug Bite.pokebase: The user attacks by biting the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Bug Bite.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Bug Buzz.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Bug Buzz.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Bug Buzz.pokebase: The user vibrates to generate a damaging sound wave. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Bug Buzz.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Bulk Up.text: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
Bulk Up.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Bulk Up.pokebase: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.
Bulk Up.smogon: Raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

Bulldoze.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Bulldoze.serebii: Lowers targets' Speed stats by 1 stage. When Grassy Terrain is active this move's power is halved.
Bulldoze.pokebase: The user strikes everything around it by stomping down on the ground. This lowers the Speed stats of those hit.
Bulldoze.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Bullet Punch.pokebase: The user strikes the target with tough punches as fast as bullets. This move always goes first.

Bullet Seed.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Bullet Seed.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Bullet Seed.pokebase: The user attacks by forcefully shooting seeds at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
Bullet Seed.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Burning Jealousy.text: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.
Burning Jealousy.serebii: Burns targets if their stats were boosted during the turn this move is used.
Burning Jealousy.pokebase: The user attacks with energy from jealousy. This leaves all opposing Pokémon that have had their stats boosted during the turn with a burn.
Burning Jealousy.smogon: Has a 100% chance to burn the target if it had a stat stage raised this turn.

Burn Up.text: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
Burn Up.serebii: The user loses the Fire type. Cures the user of being frozen. This move fails unless it is used by a Fire type.
Burn Up.pokebase: To inflict massive damage, the user burns itself out. After using this move, the user will no longer be Fire type.
Burn Up.smogon: Fails unless the user is a Fire type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Fire type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

Calm Mind.text: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Calm Mind.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.
Calm Mind.pokebase: The user quietly focuses its mind and calms its spirit to boost its Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.
Calm Mind.smogon: Raises the user's Special Attack and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Ceaseless Edge.text: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.
Ceaseless Edge.serebii: Gives the opponent's side the Spikes status.
Ceaseless Edge.pokebase: The user slashes its shell blade at the target. Shell splinters left behind by this attack remain scattered under the target as spikes.
Ceaseless Edge.smogon: If this move is successful, it sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, damaging each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. A maximum of three layers may be set, and opponents lose 1/8 of their maximum HP with one layer, 1/6 of their maximum HP with two layers, and 1/4 of their maximum HP with three layers, all rounded down. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, or is hit by Defog.

Charge.text: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.
Charge.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage. The user gains the Electric Boost status.
Charge.pokebase: The user becomes charged, boosting the power of the next Electric-type move it uses. This also boosts the user's Sp. Def stat.
Charge.smogon: Raises the user's Special Defense by 1 stage. The user's next Electric-type attack will have its power doubled; the effect ends when the user is no longer active, or after the user attempts to use any Electric-type move besides Charge, even if it is not successful.

Charge Beam.text: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Charge Beam.serebii: Has a 70% chance of boosting the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.
Charge Beam.pokebase: The user attacks the target with an electric charge. The residual electricity may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Charge Beam.smogon: Has a 70% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Charm.text: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
Charm.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 2 stages.
Charm.pokebase: The user gazes at the target rather charmingly, making it less wary. This harshly lowers the target's Attack stat.
Charm.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

Chilling Water.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Chilling Water.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Chilling Water.pokebase: The user attacks the target by showering it with water that's so cold it saps the target's power. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Chilling Water.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Chilly Reception.text: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.
Chilly Reception.serebii: Summons snow for 5 turns. The user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.
Chilly Reception.pokebase: The user tells a chillingly bad joke before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting. This summons a snowstorm lasting five turns.
Chilly Reception.smogon: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Snow. The user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members.

Circle Throw.text: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
Circle Throw.serebii: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.
Circle Throw.pokebase: The target is thrown, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
Circle Throw.smogon: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target is under the effect of Ingrain, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

Clanging Scales.text: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.
Clanging Scales.serebii: Lowers the user's Defense stat by 1 stage.
Clanging Scales.pokebase: The user rubs the scales on its entire body and makes a huge noise to attack opposing Pokémon. The user's Defense stat is lowered after the attack.
Clanging Scales.smogon: Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage.

Clangorous Soul.text: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.
Clangorous Soul.serebii: The user loses 1/3 of its max HP to boost its Attack Defense Sp. Atk Sp. Def and Speed stats by 1 stage. This move fails if the user doesn't have enough remaining HP.
Clangorous Soul.pokebase: The user boosts all its stats by using some of its own HP.
Clangorous Soul.smogon: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage in exchange for the user losing 33% of its maximum HP, rounded down. Fails if the user would faint or if its Attack, Defense, Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed stat stages would not change.

Clear Smog.text: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.
Clear Smog.serebii: Removes all stat changes from the target. This move never misses.
Clear Smog.pokebase: The user attacks the target by throwing a clump of special mud. All stat changes are eliminated.
Clear Smog.smogon: Resets all of the target's stat stages to 0.

Close Combat.text: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Close Combat.serebii: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.
Close Combat.pokebase: Lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def by 1 stage after dealing damage.
Close Combat.smogon: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Coaching.text: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.
Coaching.serebii: Boosts allies' Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Coaching.pokebase: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.
Coaching.smogon: Raises the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user.

Coil.text: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.
Coil.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy by 1 stage.
Coil.pokebase: The user coils up and concentrates. This boosts its Attack and Defense stats as well as its accuracy.
Coil.smogon: Raises the user's Attack, Defense, and accuracy by 1 stage.

Comeuppance.text: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.
Comeuppance.serebii: The user retaliates to deal 150% of the damage it took from an opponent's move during the turn this move is used.
Comeuppance.pokebase: The user retaliates with much greater force against the opponent that last inflicted damage on it.
Comeuppance.smogon: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical or special attack this turn equal to 1.5 times the HP lost by the user from that attack, rounded down. If the user did not lose HP from that attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical or special attack this turn.

Confuse Ray.text: Causes the target to become confused.
Confuse Ray.pokebase: The target is exposed to a sinister ray that causes confusion.
Confuse Ray.smogon: Causes the target to become confused.

Copycat.text: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.
Copycat.serebii: The user mimics the move that was last used. This move fails if no other move has been used yet.
Copycat.pokebase: The user mimics the move used immediately before it. The move fails if no other move has been used yet.
Copycat.smogon: The user uses the last move used by any Pokemon, including itself. Fails if no move has been used, or if the last move used was Assist, Baneful Bunker, Beak Blast, Behemoth Bash, Behemoth Blade, Belch, Bestow, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Circle Throw, Combat Torque, Copycat, Counter, Covet, Destiny Bond, Detect, Dragon Tail, Dynamax Cannon, Endure, Feint, Focus Punch, Follow Me, Helping Hand, Hold Hands, King's Shield, Magical Torque, Mat Block, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Protect, Rage Powder, Roar, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Snatch, Spiky Shield, Spotlight, Struggle, Switcheroo, Tera Starstorm, Thief, Transform, Trick, Whirlwind, or Wicked Torque.

Corrosive Gas.text: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Corrosive Gas.serebii: Causes all other Pokémon on the field to lose their held items.
Corrosive Gas.pokebase: The user surrounds everything around it with highly acidic gas and melts away items they hold.
Corrosive Gas.smogon: The target loses its held item. This move cannot cause Pokemon with the Sticky Hold Ability to lose their held item or cause a Kyogre, Groudon, Dialga, Palkia, Giratina, Arceus, Genesect, Silvally, Zacian, Zamazenta, Paradox Pokemon, or Ogerpon to lose their Blue Orb, Red Orb, Adamant Crystal, Lustrous Globe, Griseous Core, Plate, Drive, Memory, Rusted Sword, Rusted Shield, Booster Energy, or Mask, respectively. In this case, Paradox Pokemon include every species with the Protosynthesis and Quark Drive Abilities, except Gouging Fire, Raging Bolt, Iron Boulder, and Iron Crown. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Cosmic Power.text: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Cosmic Power.serebii: Boosts the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.
Cosmic Power.pokebase: The user absorbs a mystical power from space to boost its Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Cosmic Power.smogon: Raises the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Cotton Guard.text: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.
Cotton Guard.serebii: Boosts the user's Defense stat by 3 stages.
Cotton Guard.pokebase: The user protects itself by wrapping its body in soft cotton, drastically boosting its Defense stat.
Cotton Guard.smogon: Raises the user's Defense by 3 stages.

Cotton Spore.text: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
Cotton Spore.serebii: Lowers targets' Speed stats by 2 stages.
Cotton Spore.pokebase: Lowers targets' Speed stats by 2 stages. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.
Cotton Spore.smogon: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

Counter.text: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.
Counter.serebii: The user retaliates to deal double the damage it took from an opponent's physical move during the turn this move is used.
Counter.pokebase: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.
Counter.smogon: Deals damage to the last opposing Pokemon to hit the user with a physical attack this turn equal to twice the HP lost by the user from that attack. If the user did not lose HP from the attack, this move deals 1 HP of damage instead. If that opposing Pokemon's position is no longer in use and there is another opposing Pokemon on the field, the damage is done to it instead. Only the last hit of a multi-hit attack is counted. Fails if the user was not hit by an opposing Pokemon's physical attack this turn.

Court Change.text: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.
Court Change.serebii: Swaps the statuses affecting the user's side of the field with the statuses affecting the opponent's side of the field.
Court Change.pokebase: Swaps the statuses affecting the user’s side of the field with the statuses affecting the opponent’s side of the field.
Court Change.smogon: Switches the Mist, Light Screen, Reflect, Spikes, Safeguard, Tailwind, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, Water Pledge, Fire Pledge, Grass Pledge, Sticky Web, Aurora Veil, G-Max Steelsurge, G-Max Cannonade, G-Max Vine Lash, and G-Max Wildfire effects from the user's side to the opposing side and vice versa.

Covet.text: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Covet.serebii: If the user is not already holding an item it steals the target's held item.
Covet.pokebase: The user endearingly approaches the target, then steals the target's held item.
Covet.smogon: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Crabhammer.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Crabhammer.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Crabhammer.pokebase: The target is hammered with a large pincer. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Crabhammer.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Cross Chop.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Cross Chop.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Cross Chop.pokebase: The user delivers a double chop with its forearms crossed. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Cross Chop.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Cross Poison.text: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Cross Poison.serebii: Has a 10% chance of poisoning the target. This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Cross Poison.pokebase: A slashing attack with a poisonous blade that may also poison the target. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Cross Poison.smogon: Has a 10% chance to poison the target and a higher chance for a critical hit.

Crunch.text: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
Crunch.serebii: Has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage.
Crunch.pokebase: The user crunches up the target with sharp fangs. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
Crunch.smogon: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Crush Claw.text: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
Crush Claw.serebii: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage.
Crush Claw.pokebase: The user slashes the target with hard and sharp claws. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
Crush Claw.smogon: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Curse.text: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.
Curse.serebii: Ghost-type: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to give the target the Cursed status. Non-Ghost-type: Lowers the user's Speed stat by 1 stage and boosts its Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Curse.pokebase: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.
Curse.smogon: If the user is not a Ghost type, lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage and raises the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage. If the user is a Ghost type, the user loses 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down and even if it would cause fainting, in exchange for the target losing 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn while it is active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will continue to be affected. Fails if there is no target or if the target is already affected.

Darkest Lariat.text: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
Darkest Lariat.serebii: This move ignores the target's stat changes when dealing damage.
Darkest Lariat.pokebase: The user swings both arms and hits the target. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
Darkest Lariat.smogon: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

Dark Pulse.text: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.
Dark Pulse.serebii: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch.
Dark Pulse.pokebase: The user releases a horrible aura imbued with ill intent. This may also make the target flinch.
Dark Pulse.smogon: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch.

Dazzling Gleam.pokebase: The user damages opposing Pokémon by emitting a powerful flash.

Decorate.text: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.
Decorate.serebii: Boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by 2 stages.
Decorate.pokebase: The user sharply boosts the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by decorating the target.
Decorate.smogon: Raises the target's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages.

Defog.text: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.
Defog.serebii: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. Removes statuses such as Reflect Spikes and Safeguard as well as any terrain.
Defog.pokebase: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.
Defog.smogon: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 1 stage. If this move is successful and whether or not the target's evasiveness was affected, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, Aurora Veil, Safeguard, Mist, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the target's side, and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Stealth Rock, and Sticky Web end for the user's side. Ignores a target's substitute, although a substitute will still block the lowering of evasiveness. If there is a terrain active and this move is successful, the terrain will be cleared.

Destiny Bond.text: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.
Destiny Bond.serebii: The user gains the Destiny Bound status. This move fails if used in succession.
Destiny Bond.pokebase: If the user is knocked out after using this move, the Pokémon that knocked it out will also faint. This move's chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Destiny Bond.smogon: Until the user's next move, if an opposing Pokemon's attack knocks the user out, that Pokemon faints as well, unless the attack was Doom Desire or Future Sight. Fails if the user used this move successfully as its last move, disregarding moves used through the Dancer Ability.

Detect.text: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
Detect.serebii: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
Detect.pokebase: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.
Detect.smogon: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Dig.text: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Dig.serebii: The user gains the Underground status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn.
Dig.pokebase: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
Dig.smogon: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Earthquake and Magnitude but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Dire Claw.text: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.
Dire Claw.serebii: Has a 30% chance of leaving the target poisoned paralyzed or asleep.
Dire Claw.pokebase: The user lashes out at the target with ruinous claws. Has a 30% chance of leaving the target poisoned paralyzed or asleep.
Dire Claw.smogon: Has a 30% chance to cause the target to either fall asleep, become poisoned, or become paralyzed.

Disable.text: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.
Disable.serebii: Gives the target the Move Disabled status for 4 turns.
Disable.pokebase: For four turns, the target will be unable to use whichever move it last used.
Disable.smogon: For 4 turns, the target's last move used becomes disabled. Fails if one of the target's moves is already disabled, if the target has not made a move, if the target no longer knows the move, or if the move was a Max or G-Max Move.

Discharge.text: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.
Discharge.serebii: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing targets.
Discharge.pokebase: The user strikes everything around it by letting loose a flare of electricity. This may also leave those hit by the attack with paralysis.
Discharge.smogon: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target.

Dive.text: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Dive.serebii: The user gains the Submerged status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn.
Dive.pokebase: The user dives on the first turn, then floats up and attacks on the next turn.
Dive.smogon: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Surf and Whirlpool but takes double damage from them, and is also unaffected by weather. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Double-Edge.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Double-Edge.serebii: The user takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Double-Edge.pokebase: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.
Double-Edge.smogon: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Double Hit.text: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
Double Hit.serebii: The user attacks twice in a row.
Double Hit.pokebase: The user slams the target with a tail or the like. The target is hit twice in a row.
Double Hit.smogon: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

Double Shock.text: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.
Double Shock.serebii: The user loses the Electric type. This move fails unless it is used by an Electric type.
Double Shock.pokebase: The user discharges all the electricity from its body to perform a high-damage attack. After using this move, the user will no longer be Electric type.
Double Shock.smogon: Fails unless the user is an Electric type. If this move is successful and the user is not Terastallized, the user's Electric type becomes typeless as long as it remains active.

Double Team.text: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.
Double Team.serebii: Boosts the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.
Double Team.pokebase: By moving rapidly, the user makes illusory copies of itself to boost its evasiveness.
Double Team.smogon: Raises the user's evasiveness by 1 stage.

Draco Meteor.text: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.
Draco Meteor.serebii: Lowers the user's Sp. Atk stat by 2 stages.
Draco Meteor.pokebase: Comets are summoned down from the sky onto the target. The recoil from this move harshly lowers the user’s Sp. Atk stat.
Draco Meteor.smogon: Lowers the user's Special Attack by 2 stages.

Dragon Cheer.text: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
Dragon Cheer.serebii: Gives allies a Critical-Hit Ratio Boost. Dragon types receive a 2-stage boost. All other types receive a 1-stage boost.
Dragon Cheer.pokebase: The user raises its allies’ morale with a draconic cry so that their future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits. This rouses Dragon types more.
Dragon Cheer.smogon: Raises the target's chance for a critical hit by 1 stage, or by 2 stages if the target is Dragon type. Fails if there is no ally adjacent to the user, or if the target already has this effect or the Focus Energy effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

Dragon Claw.pokebase: The user slashes the target with huge, sharp claws to inflict damage.

Dragon Dance.text: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.
Dragon Dance.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats by 1 stage.
Dragon Dance.pokebase: The user vigorously performs a mystic, powerful dance that boosts its Attack and Speed stats.
Dragon Dance.smogon: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage.

Dragon Darts.text: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.
Dragon Darts.serebii: The user attacks twice in a row. If there are 2 opposing Pokémon each of them is attacked once.
Dragon Darts.pokebase: The user attacks twice using Dreepy. If there are two opposing Pokémon, this move hits each of them once.
Dragon Darts.smogon: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit. In Double Battles, this move attempts to hit the targeted Pokemon and its ally once each. If hitting one of these Pokemon would be prevented by immunity, protection, semi-invulnerability, an Ability, or accuracy, it attempts to hit the other Pokemon twice instead. If this move is redirected, it hits that target twice.

Dragon Pulse.pokebase: The target is attacked with a shock wave generated by the user's gaping mouth.

Dragon Rush.text: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
Dragon Rush.serebii: Has a 20% chance of making the target flinch. If the target has the Minimized status this move's power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.
Dragon Rush.pokebase: The user tackles the target while exhibiting overwhelming menace. This may also make the target flinch.
Dragon Rush.smogon: Has a 20% chance to make the target flinch. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

Dragon Tail.text: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.
Dragon Tail.serebii: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.
Dragon Tail.pokebase: The target is knocked away, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
Dragon Tail.smogon: If both the user and the target have not fainted, the target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. This effect fails if the target used Ingrain previously, has the Suction Cups Ability, or this move hit a substitute.

Draining Kiss.text: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
Draining Kiss.serebii: The user's HP is restored by 3/4 of the damage dealt by this move.
Draining Kiss.pokebase: The user steals the target's HP with a kiss. The user's HP is restored by over half the damage taken by the target.
Draining Kiss.smogon: The user recovers 3/4 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

Drain Punch.text: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
Drain Punch.serebii: The user's HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.
Drain Punch.pokebase: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
Drain Punch.smogon: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

Drill Peck.pokebase: A corkscrewing attack that strikes the target with a sharp beak acting as a drill.

Drill Run.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Drill Run.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Drill Run.pokebase: The user crashes into the target while rotating its body like a drill. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Drill Run.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Drum Beating.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Drum Beating.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Drum Beating.pokebase: Lowers the target’s Speed stat by 1 stage.
Drum Beating.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Dual Wingbeat.text: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
Dual Wingbeat.serebii: The user attacks twice in a row.
Dual Wingbeat.pokebase: The user slams the target with its wings to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
Dual Wingbeat.smogon: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

Dynamic Punch.text: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.
Dynamic Punch.pokebase: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.
Dynamic Punch.smogon: Has a 100% chance to confuse the target.

Earth Power.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Earth Power.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Earth Power.pokebase: The user makes the ground under the target erupt with power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Earth Power.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Earthquake.text: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.
Earthquake.serebii: This move's power is doubled against targets that have the Underground status. When Grassy Terrain is active this move's power is halved.
Earthquake.pokebase: Deals double damage to underground targets and half damage during Grassy Terrain.
Earthquake.smogon: Damage doubles if the target is using Dig.

Eerie Impulse.text: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.
Eerie Impulse.serebii: Lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat by 2 stages.
Eerie Impulse.pokebase: The user's body generates an eerie impulse. Exposing the target to it harshly lowers the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Eerie Impulse.smogon: Lowers the target's Special Attack by 2 stages.

Eerie Spell.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.
Eerie Spell.serebii: Removes 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
Eerie Spell.pokebase: The user attacks with its tremendous psychic power. This also drains 3 PP from the move last used by the target.
Eerie Spell.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the target loses 3 PP from its last move.

Electric Terrain.text: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.
Electric Terrain.serebii: Turns the entire field into Electric Terrain for 5 turns.
Electric Terrain.pokebase: The user turns the ground into Electric Terrain for five turns, powering up Electric-type moves. Pokémon on the ground can no longer fall asleep.
Electric Terrain.smogon: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Electric Terrain. During the effect, the power of Electric-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot fall asleep; Pokemon already asleep do not wake up. Grounded Pokemon cannot become affected by Yawn or fall asleep from its effect. Camouflage transforms the user into an Electric type, Nature Power becomes Thunderbolt, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause paralysis. Fails if the current terrain is Electric Terrain.

Electrify.text: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
Electrify.serebii: If this move hits the target before it uses a move its move becomes Electric type for that turn.
Electrify.pokebase: If the target is electrified before it uses a move during that turn, the target’s move becomes Electric type.
Electrify.smogon: Causes the target's move to become Electric type this turn. Among effects that can change a move's type, this effect happens last. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

Electro Ball.text: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.
Electro Ball.serebii: The higher the user's Speed stat compared to the target's the greater this move's power (ranging between 40 and 150).
Electro Ball.pokebase: The user hurls an electric orb at the target. The faster the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
Electro Ball.smogon: The power of this move depends on (user's current Speed / target's current Speed), rounded down. Power is equal to 150 if the result is 4 or more, 120 if 3, 80 if 2, 60 if 1, 40 if less than 1. If the target's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 40.

Electro Shot.text: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move still requires a turn to charge.
Electro Shot.serebii: The user gains the Charging status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn. In rain the user does not gain the Charging status and can attack immediately. The user's Sp. Atk stat is boosted by 1 stage on the turn this move is used.
Electro Shot.pokebase: The user gathers electricity on the first turn, boosting its Sp. Atk stat, then fires a high-voltage shot on the next turn. The shot will be fired immediately in rain.
Electro Shot.smogon: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. Raises the user's Special Attack by 1 stage on the first turn. If the user is holding a Power Herb or the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move completes in one turn. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella and the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, the move still requires a turn to charge.

Electroweb.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Electroweb.serebii: Lowers targets' Speed stats by 1 stage.
Electroweb.pokebase: The user captures opposing Pokémon in an electric net to inflict damage. This also lowers their Speed stats.
Electroweb.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Encore.text: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.
Encore.serebii: Gives the target the Encore status.
Encore.pokebase: The target must use its last successfully used move for the next 3 turns. Encore fails if the target has no valid last move or if its last move cannot be encored (such as Encore, Mimic, Mirror Move, Sketch, Struggle, or Transform). It also fails if the move has no remaining PP.
Encore.smogon: For its next 3 turns, the target is forced to repeat its last move used. If the affected move runs out of PP, the effect ends. Fails if the target is already under this effect, if it has not made a move, if the move has 0 PP, or if the move is Assist, Blazing Torque, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Encore, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Transform, or Wicked Torque.

Endeavor.text: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.
Endeavor.serebii: Deals damage to the target equal to its remaining HP minus the user's remaining HP. This move fails if the target's HP is the same as or lower than the user's.
Endeavor.pokebase: The user inflicts damage by cutting down the target's HP to roughly equal the user's HP.
Endeavor.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to (target's current HP - user's current HP). The target is unaffected if its current HP is less than or equal to the user's current HP.

Endure.text: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used.
