X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
Endure.serebii: During the turn this move is used if the user takes damage from a move that would knock it out it will endure the hit with 1 HP. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
Endure.pokebase: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.
Endure.smogon: The user will survive attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn with at least 1 HP. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Energy Ball.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Energy Ball.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Energy Ball.pokebase: The user draws power from nature and fires it at the target. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Energy Ball.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Entrainment.text: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
Entrainment.serebii: Changes the target's Ability to be the same as the user's.
Entrainment.pokebase: The user dances with an odd rhythm that compels the target to mimic it, making the target's Ability the same as the user's.
Entrainment.smogon: Causes the target's Ability to become the same as the user's. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, or the same Ability as the user, or if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Eruption.text: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.
Eruption.serebii: The less HP the user has left the lower this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).
Eruption.pokebase: The user attacks opposing Pokémon with explosive fury. The lower the user's HP, the lower the move's power.
Eruption.smogon: Power is equal to (user's current HP × 150 / user's maximum HP), rounded down, but not less than 1.

Expanding Force.text: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.
Expanding Force.serebii: If the user is under the effect of Psychic Terrain this move's power is boosted by 50% and its range extends to all opponents.
Expanding Force.pokebase: The user attacks the target with its psychic power. When the ground is Psychic Terrain, this move's power is boosted and it damages all opposing Pokémon.
Expanding Force.smogon: If the current terrain is Psychic Terrain and the user is grounded, this move hits all opposing Pokemon and has its power multiplied by 1.5.

Explosion.text: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
Explosion.serebii: The user faints upon using this move.
Explosion.pokebase: The user attacks everything around it by causing a tremendous explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
Explosion.smogon: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

Extrasensory.text: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.
Extrasensory.serebii: Has a 10% chance of making the target flinch.
Extrasensory.pokebase: The user attacks with an odd, unseeable power. This may also make the target flinch.
Extrasensory.smogon: Has a 10% chance to make the target flinch.

Extreme Speed.pokebase: The user charges the target at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

Facade.text: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.
Facade.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned badly poisoned burned or paralyzed. Although this move is a physical move the damage it deals is not halved when the user is burned.
Facade.pokebase: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.
Facade.smogon: Power doubles if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned. The physical damage halving effect from the user's burn is ignored.

Fairy Lock.text: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.
Fairy Lock.serebii: Gives all Pokémon on the field the Fairy Locked status.
Fairy Lock.pokebase: By locking down the battlefield, the user keeps all Pokémon from fleeing during the next turn.
Fairy Lock.smogon: Prevents all active Pokemon from switching next turn. A Pokemon can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. Fails if the effect is already active.

Fake Out.text: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
Fake Out.serebii: Makes the target flinch. This move fails unless it is the first move used by the user after it enters a battle.
Fake Out.pokebase: This attack hits first and makes the target flinch. It works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
Fake Out.smogon: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

Fake Tears.text: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.
Fake Tears.serebii: Lowers the target's Sp. Def stat by 2 stages.
Fake Tears.pokebase: The user feigns crying to fluster the target. This harshly lowers the target's Sp. Def stat.
Fake Tears.smogon: Lowers the target's Special Defense by 2 stages.

Feather Dance.text: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.
Feather Dance.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 2 stages.
Feather Dance.pokebase: The user covers the target's body with a mass of down that harshly lowers its Attack stat.
Feather Dance.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack by 2 stages.

Feint.text: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.
Feint.serebii: This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.
Feint.pokebase: This attack can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect. This also lifts the effects of those moves.
Feint.smogon: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally.

Fell Stinger.text: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.
Fell Stinger.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack stat by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.
Fell Stinger.pokebase: When the user knocks out a target with this move, the user's Attack stat is boosted drastically.
Fell Stinger.smogon: Raises the user's Attack by 3 stages if this move knocks out the target.

Fickle Beam.text: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.
Fickle Beam.serebii: This move has a 30% chance of its power being doubled.
Fickle Beam.pokebase: The user shoots a beam of light to inflict damage. Sometimes all the user's heads shoot beams in unison, doubling the move's power.
Fickle Beam.smogon: Has a 30% chance this move's power is doubled.

Fiery Dance.text: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Fiery Dance.serebii: Has a 50% chance of boosting the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.
Fiery Dance.pokebase: Cloaked in flames, the user attacks the target by dancing and flapping its wings. This may also boost the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Fiery Dance.smogon: Has a 50% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Final Gambit.text: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.
Final Gambit.serebii: The user faints. This move deals damage to the target equal to the user's remaining HP at the time this move was used.
Final Gambit.pokebase: The user risks everything to attack the target. The user faints but inflicts damage equal to its own HP.
Final Gambit.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's current HP. If this move is successful, the user faints.

Fire Blast.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
Fire Blast.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target.
Fire Blast.pokebase: The target is attacked with an intense blast of all-consuming fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Fire Blast.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

Fire Fang.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
Fire Fang.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.
Fire Fang.pokebase: The user bites with flame-cloaked fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with a burn.
Fire Fang.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

Fire Lash.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Fire Lash.pokebase: The user strikes the target with a burning lash. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
Fire Lash.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Fire Punch.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
Fire Punch.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target.
Fire Punch.pokebase: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Fire Punch.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

Fire Spin.text: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
Fire Spin.serebii: Gives the target the Bound status.
Fire Spin.pokebase: The user traps the target inside a fierce vortex of fire that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
Fire Spin.smogon: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

First Impression.text: This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.
First Impression.serebii: This move fails unless it is the first move used by the user after it enters a battle.
First Impression.pokebase: Although this move has great power, it works only on the first turn each time the user enters battle.
First Impression.smogon: This move cannot be selected unless it is the user's first turn on the field.

Fissure.text: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
Fissure.serebii: Knocks out the target. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%.
Fissure.pokebase: The user opens up a fissure in the ground and drops the target in. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.
Fissure.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

Flail.text: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
Flail.serebii: The less HP the user has left the greater this move's power (ranging between 20 and 200).
Flail.pokebase: The user flails about aimlessly to attack. The less HP the user has, the greater the move's power.
Flail.smogon: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

Flame Charge.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Flame Charge.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Flame Charge.pokebase: Cloaking itself in flame, the user attacks the target. Then, building up momentum, the user boosts its Speed stat.

Flamethrower.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
Flamethrower.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target.
Flamethrower.pokebase: The target is scorched with an intense blast of fire. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Flamethrower.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

Flare Blitz.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Flare Blitz.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target. Cures the user of being frozen. The user also takes 1/3 of the damage dealt by this move.
Flare Blitz.pokebase: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. Thaws the user if frozen. The user takes recoil damage equal to 1/3 of the damage dealt.
Flare Blitz.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target. If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 33% the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.

Flash Cannon.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Flash Cannon.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Flash Cannon.pokebase: The user gathers all its light energy and releases it at once. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Flash Cannon.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Flatter.text: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.
Flatter.serebii: Boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage and confuses it.
Flatter.pokebase: Flattery is used to confuse the target. However, this also boosts the target's Sp. Atk stat.
Flatter.smogon: Raises the target's Special Attack by 1 stage and confuses it.

Fling.text: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.
Fling.serebii: This move's power and effects depend on the user's held item. The held item is lost after this move is used.
Fling.pokebase: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.
Fling.smogon: The power of this move is based on the user's held item. The held item is lost and it activates for the target if applicable. If there is no target or the target avoids this move by protecting itself, the user's held item is still lost. The user can regain a thrown item with Recycle or the Harvest Ability. Fails if the user has no held item, if the held item cannot be thrown, if the user is under the effect of Embargo or Magic Room, or if the user has the Klutz Ability.

Flip Turn.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
Flip Turn.serebii: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.
Flip Turn.pokebase: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
Flip Turn.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

Flower Trick.text: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.
Flower Trick.serebii: This move never misses and is always a critical hit.
Flower Trick.pokebase: The user throws a rigged bouquet of flowers at the target. This attack never misses and always lands a critical hit.
Flower Trick.smogon: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities. This move does not check accuracy.

Fly.text: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Fly.serebii: The user gains the Sky-High status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn.
Fly.pokebase: The user flies up into the sky on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.
Fly.smogon: This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks other than Gust, Hurricane, Sky Uppercut, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, Thunder, and Twister, and Gust and Twister have doubled power when used against it. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Flying Press.text: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.
Flying Press.serebii: The damage dealt by this move is calculated by combining the effectiveness of the move's own type with that of the Flying type. If the target has the Minimized status this move's power is doubled and it will be sure to hit.
Flying Press.pokebase: The user dives down onto the target from the sky. This move is Fighting and Flying type simultaneously.
Flying Press.smogon: This move combines Flying in its type effectiveness against the target. Damage doubles and no accuracy check is done if the target has used Minimize while active.

Focus Blast.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Focus Blast.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Focus Blast.pokebase: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.
Focus Blast.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Focus Energy.text: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.
Focus Energy.serebii: The user gains a 2-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Focus Energy.pokebase: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.
Focus Energy.smogon: Raises the user's chance for a critical hit by 2 stages. Fails if the user already has the effect. Baton Pass can be used to transfer this effect to an ally.

Focus Punch.text: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.
Focus Punch.serebii: This move fails if the user has already taken damage from a move in the same turn.
Focus Punch.pokebase: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.
Focus Punch.smogon: The user loses its focus and does nothing if it is hit by a damaging attack this turn before it can execute the move.

Follow Me.text: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
Follow Me.serebii: The user redirects opponents' moves toward itself. This effect works only on single-target moves.
Follow Me.pokebase: The user draws attention to itself, making all opposing Pokémon take aim only at the user.
Follow Me.smogon: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

Forest's Curse.text: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
Forest's Curse.serebii: Gives the target the Forest Cursed status.
Forest's Curse.smogon: Causes the Grass type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Grass type. If Trick-or-Treat adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

Foul Play.text: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.
Foul Play.serebii: The damage dealt by this move is calculated using the target's Attack stat instead of the user's Attack stat.
Foul Play.pokebase: The user turns the target's strength against it. The higher the target's Attack stat, the greater the damage this move inflicts.
Foul Play.smogon: Damage is calculated using the target's Attack stat, including stat stage changes. The user's Ability, item, and burn are used as normal.

Freeze-Dry.text: This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.
Freeze-Dry.serebii: This move is also super effective against Water-type Pokémon.
Freeze-Dry.pokebase: The user rapidly cools the target. This may also leave the target frozen. This move is super effective on Water types.
Freeze-Dry.smogon: This move's type effectiveness against Water is changed to be super effective no matter what this move's type is.

Frenzy Plant.text: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
Frenzy Plant.serebii: The user gains the Recharging status on the turn after this move is used.
Frenzy Plant.pokebase: The user slams the target with the roots of an enormous tree. The user can't move on the next turn.
Frenzy Plant.smogon: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

Frost Breath.text: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.
Frost Breath.pokebase: The user attacks by blowing its cold breath on the target. This move always lands a critical hit.
Frost Breath.smogon: This move is always a critical hit unless the target is under the effect of Lucky Chant or has the Battle Armor or Shell Armor Abilities.

Future Sight.text: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.
Future Sight.serebii: Gives the target's spot the Future Attack status.
Future Sight.pokebase: Two turns after this move is used, a hunk of psychic energy attacks the target.
Future Sight.smogon: Deals damage two turns after this move is used. At the end of that turn, the damage is calculated at that time and dealt to the Pokemon at the position the target had when the move was used. If the user is no longer active at the time, damage is calculated based on the user's natural Special Attack stat, types, and level, with no boosts from its held item or Ability. Fails if this move or Doom Desire is already in effect for the target's position.

Gastro Acid.text: Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.
Gastro Acid.serebii: Gives the target the No Ability status.
Gastro Acid.pokebase: The user hurls up its stomach acids on the target. The fluid eliminates the effect of the target's Ability.
Gastro Acid.smogon: Causes the target's Ability to be rendered ineffective as long as it remains active. If the target uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain under this effect. If the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero, this move fails, and receiving the effect through Baton Pass ends the effect immediately.

Giga Drain.text: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.
Giga Drain.serebii: The user's HP is restored by 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.
Giga Drain.pokebase: A nutrient-draining attack. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.
Giga Drain.smogon: The user recovers 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up. If Big Root is held by the user, the HP recovered is 1.3× normal, rounded half down.

Giga Impact.text: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

Gigaton Hammer.text: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

Gigaton Hammer.pokebase: The user swings its whole body around to attack with its huge hammer. This move can't be used twice in a row.
Gigaton Hammer.smogon: Cannot be selected the turn after it's used.

Glaive Rush.text: If this move is successful, moves targeted at the user deal double damage and do not check accuracy until the user's next turn.
Glaive Rush.serebii: The user gains the Wide Open status until the next time it takes an action.
Glaive Rush.pokebase: The user gains the Wide Open status until the next time it takes an action.
Glaive Rush.smogon: If this move is successful, moves targeted at the user deal double damage and do not check accuracy until the user's next turn.

Glare.pokebase: The user intimidates the target with the pattern on its belly to cause paralysis.

Grass Knot.text: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.
Grass Knot.serebii: The heavier the target the greater this move's power (ranging between 20 and 120).
Grass Knot.pokebase: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.
Grass Knot.smogon: This move's power is 20 if the target weighs less than 10 kg, 40 if less than 25 kg, 60 if less than 50 kg, 80 if less than 100 kg, 100 if less than 200 kg, and 120 if greater than or equal to 200 kg.

Grassy Glide.text: If the current terrain is Grassy Terrain and the user is grounded, this move has its priority increased by 1.
Grassy Glide.serebii: If the user is under the effect of Grassy Terrain this move's priority becomes +1.
Grassy Glide.pokebase: Gliding on the ground, the user attacks the target. This move always goes first on Grassy Terrain.
Grassy Glide.smogon: If the current terrain is Grassy Terrain and the user is grounded, this move has its priority increased by 1.

Grassy Terrain.text: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.
Grassy Terrain.serebii: Turns the entire field into Grassy Terrain for 5 turns.
Grassy Terrain.pokebase: The user turns the ground into Grassy Terrain for five turns. This restores the HP of Pokémon on the ground a little every turn and powers up Grass-type moves.
Grassy Terrain.smogon: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Grassy Terrain. During the effect, the power of Grass-type attacks used by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3, the power of Bulldoze, Earthquake, and Magnitude used against grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 0.5, and grounded Pokemon have 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, restored at the end of each turn, including the last turn. Camouflage transforms the user into a Grass type, Nature Power becomes Energy Ball, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to cause sleep. Fails if the current terrain is Grassy Terrain.

Grav Apple.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.
Grav Apple.serebii: Lowers the target's Defense stat by 1 stage. This move's power is boosted by 50% when the Gravity status is active.
Grav Apple.pokebase: The user inflicts damage by dropping an apple from high above. This also lowers the target's Defense stat.
Grav Apple.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage. Power is multiplied by 1.5 during Gravity's effect.

Gravity.text: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.
Gravity.serebii: Gives the entire field the Gravity status for 5 turns.
Gravity.pokebase: Enables Flying types or Pokémon with the Levitate Ability to be hit by Ground-type moves for five turns. Moves that involve flying can't be used.
Gravity.smogon: For 5 turns, the evasiveness of all active Pokemon is multiplied by 0.6. At the time of use, Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, and Telekinesis end immediately for all active Pokemon. During the effect, Bounce, Fly, Flying Press, High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, Magnet Rise, Sky Drop, Splash, and Telekinesis are prevented from being used by all active Pokemon. Ground-type attacks, Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability can affect Flying types or Pokemon with the Levitate Ability. Fails if this move is already in effect.

Growth.text: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.
Growth.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by 1 stage. In harsh sunlight these stats will be boosted by 2 stages instead.
Growth.pokebase: The user's body grows all at once, boosting the Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
Growth.smogon: Raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage. If the weather is Sun or Intense Sun, this move raises the user's Attack and Special Attack by 2 stages. If the user is holding Utility Umbrella, this move will only raise the user's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage, even if the weather is Sun or Intense Sun.

Guard Split.text: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
Guard Split.serebii: The user adds its Defense stat to the target's Defense stat then splits the total in half for them to share. It does the same with each of their Sp. Def stats.
Guard Split.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to average its Defense and Sp. Def stats with those of the target.
Guard Split.smogon: The user and the target have their Defense and Special Defense stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Defense and Special Defense stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

Guard Swap.text: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.
Guard Swap.serebii: The user swaps the changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the changes to the target's Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Guard Swap.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Defense and Sp. Def stats with the target.
Guard Swap.smogon: The user swaps its Defense and Special Defense stat stage changes with the target.

Guillotine.text: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + 30)%, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
Guillotine.serebii: Knocks out the target. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%.
Guillotine.pokebase: A vicious tearing attack with big pincers. The target faints instantly if this attack hits.

Gunk Shot.text: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Gunk Shot.serebii: Has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.

Gunk Shot.smogon: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

Gyro Ball.text: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.
Gyro Ball.serebii: The lower the user's Speed stat compared to the target's the greater this move's power (ranging between 1 and 150).
Gyro Ball.pokebase: The user tackles the target with a high-speed spin. The slower the user is than the target, the greater the move's power.
Gyro Ball.smogon: Power is equal to (25 * target's current Speed / user's current Speed) + 1, rounded down, but not more than 150. If the user's current Speed is 0, this move's power is 1.

Hammer Arm.text: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Hammer Arm.pokebase: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.
Hammer Arm.smogon: Lowers the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Hard Press.text: Power is equal to 100 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.
Hard Press.serebii: The more HP the target has left the greater this move's power (ranging between 1 and 100).
Hard Press.pokebase: The target is crushed with an arm, a claw, or the like to inflict damage. The more HP the target has left, the greater the move's power.
Hard Press.smogon: Power is equal to 100 × (target's current HP / target's maximum HP), rounded half down, but not less than 1.

Haze.text: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.
Haze.serebii: Eliminates every stat change on the entire field.
Haze.pokebase: The user creates a haze that eliminates every stat change among all the Pokémon engaged in battle.
Haze.smogon: Resets the stat stages of all active Pokemon to 0.

Headlong Rush.text: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.
Headlong Rush.serebii: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage.
Headlong Rush.pokebase: The user smashes into the target in a full-body tackle. This also lowers the user’s Defense and Sp. Def stats.
Headlong Rush.smogon: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage.

Head Smash.text: If the target lost HP, the user takes recoil damage equal to 1/2 the HP lost by the target, rounded half up, but not less than 1 HP.
Head Smash.serebii: The user takes 1/2 of the damage dealt by this move.
Head Smash.pokebase: The user attacks the target with a hazardous full-power headbutt. This also damages the user terribly.

Heal Bell.text: Every Pokemon in the user's party is cured of its non-volatile status condition. Active Pokemon with the Soundproof Ability are not cured, unless they are the user.

Healing Wish.text: The user faints, and if the Pokemon brought out to replace it does not have full HP or has a non-volatile status condition, its HP is fully restored along with having any non-volatile status condition cured. The replacement is sent out at the end of the turn, and the healing happens before hazards take effect. This effect continues until a Pokemon that meets either of these conditions switches in at the user's position or gets swapped into the position with Ally Switch. Fails if the user is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party.

Payback.pokebase: The user stores power, then attacks. This move's power is doubled if the user moves after the target.
Payback.smogon: Power doubles if the user moves after the target this turn, including actions taken through Instruct or the Dancer Ability. Switching in does not count as an action.

Perish Song.text: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.
Perish Song.serebii: Gives all Pokémon on the field the Perishing status.
Perish Song.pokebase: Any Pokémon that hears this song faints in three turns, unless it switches out of battle.
Perish Song.smogon: Each active Pokemon receives a perish count of 4 if it doesn't already have a perish count. At the end of each turn including the turn used, the perish count of all active Pokemon lowers by 1 and Pokemon faint if the number reaches 0. The perish count is removed from Pokemon that switch out. If a Pokemon uses Baton Pass while it has a perish count, the replacement will gain the perish count and continue to count down.

Petal Blizzard.pokebase: The user stirs up a violent petal blizzard and damages everything around it.

Petal Dance.text: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
Petal Dance.serebii: The user gains the Rampaging status.
Petal Dance.pokebase: The user attacks the target by scattering petals for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
Petal Dance.smogon: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

Phantom Force.text: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Phantom Force.serebii: The user gains the Concealed status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn. This move can hit a target using a move such as Protect or Detect and removes the effects of those moves.
Phantom Force.pokebase: The user vanishes somewhere, then strikes the target on the next turn. This move hits even if the target protects itself.
Phantom Force.smogon: If this move is successful, it breaks through the target's Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, or Spiky Shield for this turn, allowing other Pokemon to attack the target normally. If the target's side is protected by Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard, that protection is also broken for this turn and other Pokemon may attack the target's side normally. This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. On the first turn, the user avoids all attacks. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.

Pin Missile.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Pin Missile.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Pin Missile.pokebase: The user attacks by shooting sharp spikes at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
Pin Missile.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Play Rough.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Play Rough.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Play Rough.pokebase: The user attacks by playing rough with the target. This may also lower the target's Attack stat.
Play Rough.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Pluck.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Pluck.serebii: If the target is holding a Berry the user eats that Berry and gains its effect.
Pluck.pokebase: The user attacks by pecking the target. If the target is holding a Berry, the user eats it and gains its effect.
Pluck.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, it steals the target's held Berry if it is holding one and eats it immediately, gaining its effects even if the user's item is being ignored. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Poison Fang.text: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.
Poison Fang.serebii: Has a 50% chance of badly poisoning the target.
Poison Fang.pokebase: The user bites the target with toxic fangs. This may also leave the target badly poisoned.
Poison Fang.smogon: Has a 50% chance to badly poison the target.

Poison Jab.text: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.
Poison Jab.serebii: Has a 30% chance of poisoning the target.
Poison Jab.pokebase: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.
Poison Jab.smogon: Has a 30% chance to poison the target.

Poison Powder.pokebase: Poisons the target. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

Pollen Puff.text: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.
Pollen Puff.serebii: When used on an ally this move restores 1/2 of its max HP instead of dealing damage.
Pollen Puff.pokebase: The user attacks the enemy with a pollen puff that explodes. If the target is an ally, it gives the ally a pollen puff that restores its HP instead.
Pollen Puff.smogon: If the target is an ally, this move restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded down, instead of dealing damage.

Poltergeist.text: Fails if the target has no held item.
Poltergeist.serebii: This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
Poltergeist.pokebase: The user attacks by controlling the target's item. This move fails if the target isn't holding an item.
Poltergeist.smogon: Fails if the target has no held item.

Population Bomb.text: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.
Population Bomb.serebii: The user attacks 1 to 10 times in a row. The attack ends if the user misses.
Population Bomb.pokebase: The user’s fellows gather in droves to perform a combo attack that hits the target one to ten times in a row.
Population Bomb.smogon: Hits ten times. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit ten times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move hits four to ten times at random without checking accuracy between hits.

Pounce.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Pounce.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Pounce.pokebase: The user attacks by pouncing on the target. This also lowers the target's Speed stat.
Pounce.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Pound.pokebase: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

Power Gem.pokebase: The user attacks with a ray of light that sparkles as if it were made of gemstones.

Power Split.text: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.
Power Split.serebii: The user adds its Attack stat to the target's Attack stat then splits the total in half for them to share. It does the same with each of their Sp. Atk stats.
Power Split.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to average its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with those of the target.
Power Split.smogon: The user and the target have their Attack and Special Attack stats set to be equal to the average of the user and the target's Attack and Special Attack stats, respectively, rounded down. Stat stage changes are unaffected.

Power Swap.text: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.
Power Swap.serebii: The user swaps the changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the changes to the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
Power Swap.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to switch changes to its Attack and Sp. Atk stats with the target.
Power Swap.smogon: The user swaps its Attack and Special Attack stat stage changes with the target.

Power Trick.text: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.
Power Trick.serebii: The user gains the Atk/Def Swapped status.
Power Trick.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to switch its Attack stat with its Defense stat.
Power Trick.smogon: The user swaps its Attack and Defense stats, and stat stage changes remain on their respective stats. This move can be used again to swap the stats back. If the user uses Baton Pass, the replacement will have its Attack and Defense stats swapped if the effect is active. If the user has its stats recalculated by changing forme while its stats are swapped, this effect is ignored but is still active for the purposes of Baton Pass.

Power Trip.text: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.
Power Trip.serebii: This move's power is increased by 20 for each stage that the user's stats have been boosted.
Power Trip.pokebase: The user boasts its strength and attacks the target. The more the user's stats are boosted, the greater the move's power.
Power Trip.smogon: Power is equal to 20+(X × 20), where X is the user's total stat stage changes that are greater than 0.

Power Whip.pokebase: The user violently whirls its vines, tentacles, or the like to lash the target.

Protect.text: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.
Protect.serebii: The user protects itself from incoming moves for the turn. With each consecutive use this move's chance of success becomes 1/3 of what it was before.
Protect.pokebase: Protects the user from most targeted moves for the turn. Each consecutive use has a 1/3 chance of succeeding.
Protect.smogon: The user is protected from most attacks made by other Pokemon during this turn. This move has a 1/X chance of being successful, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn.

Psychic.text: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Psychic.serebii: Has a 10% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Psychic.pokebase: The target is hit with a strong telekinetic force to inflict damage. This may also lower the target’s Sp. Def stat.
Psychic.smogon: Has a 10% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Psychic Fangs.text: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.
Psychic Fangs.serebii: Removes the Light Screen Reflect and Aurora Veil statuses on the target's side.
Psychic Fangs.pokebase: The user attacks by biting the target with its psychic capabilities. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
Psychic Fangs.smogon: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated.

Psychic Noise.text: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.
Psychic Noise.serebii: Gives the target the Healing Prevented status for 2 turns.
Psychic Noise.pokebase: The user attacks the target with unpleasant sound waves. For two turns, the target is prevented from recovering HP through moves, Abilities, or held items.
Psychic Noise.smogon: For 2 turns, the target is prevented from restoring any HP as long as it remains active. During the effect, healing and draining moves are unusable, and Abilities and items that grant healing will not heal the user. If an affected Pokemon uses Baton Pass, the replacement will remain unable to restore its HP. Pain Split and the Regenerator Ability are unaffected.

Psychic Terrain.text: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.
Psychic Terrain.serebii: Turns the entire field into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns.
Psychic Terrain.pokebase: This protects Pokémon on the ground from priority moves and powers up Psychic-type moves for five turns.
Psychic Terrain.smogon: For 5 turns, the terrain becomes Psychic Terrain. During the effect, the power of Psychic-type attacks made by grounded Pokemon is multiplied by 1.3 and grounded Pokemon cannot be hit by moves with priority greater than 0, unless the target is an ally. Camouflage transforms the user into a Psychic type, Nature Power becomes Psychic, and Secret Power has a 30% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage. Fails if the current terrain is Psychic Terrain.

Psycho Cut.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Psycho Cut.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Psycho Cut.pokebase: The user tears at the target with blades formed by psychic power. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Psycho Cut.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Psych Up.text: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.
Psych Up.serebii: The user copies the target's stat changes.
Psych Up.pokebase: The user hypnotizes itself into copying any stat change made by the target.
Psych Up.smogon: The user copies all of the target's current stat stage changes.

Psyshield Bash.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.
Psyshield Bash.serebii: Boosts the user's Defense stat by 1 stage.
Psyshield Bash.pokebase: Cloaking itself in psychic energy, the user slams into the target. This also boosts the user’s Defense stat.
Psyshield Bash.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Defense by 1 stage.

Psyshock.text: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.
Psyshock.serebii: This is a special move but the damage it deals is calculated using the target's Defense stat.
Psyshock.pokebase: The user materializes an odd psychic wave to attack the target. This move deals physical damage.
Psyshock.smogon: Deals damage to the target based on its Defense instead of Special Defense.

Pyro Ball.text: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.
Pyro Ball.serebii: Has a 10% chance of burning the target. Cures the user of being frozen.
Pyro Ball.pokebase: Has a 10% chance of burning the target. Cures the user of being frozen.
Pyro Ball.smogon: Has a 10% chance to burn the target.

Quash.text: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.
Quash.serebii: Causes the target to move last in the turn.
Quash.pokebase: The user suppresses the target and makes its move go last.
Quash.smogon: Causes the target to take its turn after all other Pokemon this turn, no matter the priority of its selected move. Fails if the target already moved this turn.

Quick Attack.pokebase: The user lunges at the target to inflict damage, moving at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

Quick Guard.text: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
Quick Guard.serebii: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves for the turn.
Quick Guard.pokebase: The user protects itself and its allies from priority moves.
Quick Guard.smogon: The user and its party members are protected from attacks with original or altered priority greater than 0 made by other Pokemon, including allies, during this turn. This move modifies the same 1/X chance of being successful used by other protection moves, where X starts at 1 and triples each time this move is successfully used, but does not use the chance to check for failure. X resets to 1 if this move fails, if the user's last move used is not Baneful Bunker, Burning Bulwark, Detect, Endure, King's Shield, Max Guard, Obstruct, Protect, Quick Guard, Silk Trap, Spiky Shield, or Wide Guard, or if it was one of those moves and the user's protection was broken. Fails if the user moves last this turn or if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

Quiver Dance.text: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.
Quiver Dance.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Atk Sp. Def and Speed stats by 1 stage.
Quiver Dance.pokebase: The user lightly performs a beautiful, mystic dance. This boosts the user's Sp. Atk, Sp. Def, and Speed stats.
Quiver Dance.smogon: Raises the user's Special Attack, Special Defense, and Speed by 1 stage.

Rage Fist.text: Power is equal to 50+(X × 50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and resets to 0 when the user leaves the field. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.
Rage Fist.serebii: This move's power is increased by 50 each time the user takes damage from a move, up to a maximum power of 350. If the user switches out of battle, the move's power returns to its usual value.
Rage Fist.pokebase: The user converts its rage into energy to attack. The more times the user has been hit by attacks, the greater the move's power.
Rage Fist.smogon: Power is equal to 50+(X × 50), where X is the total number of times the user has been hit by a damaging attack during the battle, even if the user did not lose HP from the attack. X cannot be greater than 6 and resets to 0 when the user leaves the field. Each hit of a multi-hit attack is counted, but confusion damage is not counted.

Rage Powder.text: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.
Rage Powder.serebii: The user redirects opponents' moves toward itself. This effect works only on single-target moves.
Rage Powder.pokebase: The user redirects opponents' moves toward itself. This effect works only on single-target moves. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.
Rage Powder.smogon: Until the end of the turn, all single-target attacks from the opposing side are redirected to the user. Such attacks are redirected to the user before they can be reflected by Magic Coat or the Magic Bounce Ability, or drawn in by the Lightning Rod or Storm Drain Abilities. Fails if it is not a Double Battle or Battle Royal. This effect is ignored while the user is under the effect of Sky Drop.

Raging Bull.text: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.
Raging Bull.serebii: Removes the Light Screen Reflect and Aurora Veil statuses on the target's side. This move's type depends on the user's form.
Raging Bull.pokebase: The user performs a tackle like a raging bull. This move's type depends on the user's form. It can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.
Raging Bull.smogon: If this attack does not miss, the effects of Reflect, Light Screen, and Aurora Veil end for the target's side of the field before damage is calculated. If the user's current form is a Paldean Tauros, this move's type changes to match. Fighting type for Combat Breed, Fire type for Blaze Breed, and Water type for Aqua Breed.

Raging Fury.text: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
Raging Fury.serebii: The user gains the Rampaging status.
Raging Fury.pokebase: The user rampages around spewing flames for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
Raging Fury.smogon: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

Rain Dance.text: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.
Rain Dance.pokebase: Summons rain for 5 turns, boosting Water-type moves by 50% and reducing Fire-type moves by 50%.
Rain Dance.smogon: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Rain. The damage of Water-type attacks is multiplied by 1.5 and the damage of Fire-type attacks is multiplied by 0.5 during the effect. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Damp Rock. Fails if the current weather is Rain.

Rapid Spin.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Rapid Spin.serebii: Removes the Bound and Leech Seeded statuses from the user and removes the Sticky Web Stealth Rock Spikes and Toxic Spikes statuses from the user's side. Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Rapid Spin.pokebase: The user performs a spin attack that can also eliminate the effects of such moves as Bind, Wrap, and Leech Seed. This also boosts the user's Speed stat.
Rapid Spin.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the effects of Leech Seed and binding moves end for the user, and all hazards are removed from the user's side of the field. Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Razor Shell.text: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.
Razor Shell.serebii: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage.
Razor Shell.pokebase: The user cuts the target with sharp shells to inflict damage. This may also lower the target's Defense stat.
Razor Shell.smogon: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage.

Recover.text: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.
Recover.serebii: Restores 1/2 of the user's max HP.
Recover.pokebase: The user regenerates its cells, restoring its own HP by up to half its max HP.
Recover.smogon: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up.

Recycle.text: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.
Recycle.serebii: Regenerates the last held item that the user consumed. The user then holds this item once more.
Recycle.pokebase: The user recycles a held item that has been used in battle so it can be used again.
Recycle.smogon: The user regains the item it last used. Fails if the user is holding an item, if the user has not held an item, if the item was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by a Pokemon with the Pickup Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be regained.

Reflect.text: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
Reflect.serebii: Gives the user's side the Reflect status for 5 turns.
Reflect.pokebase: A wondrous wall of light is put up to reduce damage from physical moves for five turns.
Reflect.smogon: For 5 turns, the user and its party members take 0.5× damage from physical attacks, or 0.66× damage if in a Double Battle. Damage is not reduced further with Aurora Veil. Critical hits ignore this effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Brick Break, Psychic Fangs, or Defog. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Light Clay. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

Reflect Type.text: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.
Reflect Type.serebii: The user becomes the same type or types as the target.
Reflect Type.pokebase: The user reflects the target's type to become the same type as the target.
Reflect Type.smogon: Causes the user's types to become the same as the current types of the target. If the target's current types include typeless and a non-added type, typeless is ignored. If the target's current types include typeless and an added type from Forest's Curse or Trick-or-Treat, typeless is copied as the Normal type instead. Fails if the user is an Arceus or a Silvally, if the user is Terastallized, or if the target's current type is typeless alone.

Rest.text: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.
Rest.serebii: Fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions. The user falls asleep for 2 turns. This move fails if the user's HP is full.
Rest.pokebase: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.
Rest.smogon: The user falls asleep for the next two turns and restores all of its HP, curing itself of any non-volatile status condition in the process. Fails if the user has full HP, is already asleep, or if another effect is preventing sleep.

Reversal.text: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.
Reversal.serebii: The less HP the user has left the greater this move's power (ranging between 20 and 200).
Reversal.pokebase: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.
Reversal.smogon: The power of this move is 20 if X is 33 to 48, 40 if X is 17 to 32, 80 if X is 10 to 16, 100 if X is 5 to 9, 150 if X is 2 to 4, and 200 if X is 0 or 1, where X is equal to (user's current HP × 48 / user's maximum HP), rounded down.

Revival Blessing.text: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.
Revival Blessing.serebii: Revives a Pokémon in the user's party that has fainted and restores 1/2 of that Pokémon's max HP.
Revival Blessing.pokebase: The user bestows a loving blessing, reviving a party Pokémon that has fainted and restoring half that Pokémon's max HP.
Revival Blessing.smogon: A fainted party member is selected and revived with 1/2 its max HP, rounded down. Fails if there are no fainted party members.

Rising Voltage.text: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.
Rising Voltage.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the target is under the effect of Electric Terrain.
Rising Voltage.pokebase: The user attacks with electricity rising from the ground. This move's power is doubled if the target is on Electric Terrain.
Rising Voltage.smogon: If the current terrain is Electric Terrain and the target is grounded, this move's power is doubled.

Roar.text: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.
Roar.serebii: If there are other Pokémon in the target's party that can switch into battle the target is forced to switch out of battle and is replaced by one of those Pokémon at random.
Roar.pokebase: The target is scared off, and a different Pokémon is dragged out. In the wild, this ends a battle against a single Pokémon.
Roar.smogon: The target is forced to switch out and be replaced with a random unfainted ally. Fails if the target is the last unfainted Pokemon in its party, or if the target used Ingrain previously or has the Suction Cups Ability.

Rock Blast.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Rock Blast.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Rock Blast.pokebase: The user attacks by hurling hard rocks at the target. This move hits two to five times in a row.
Rock Blast.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Rock Polish.text: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.
Rock Polish.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 2 stages.
Rock Polish.pokebase: The user polishes its body to reduce drag. This sharply boosts the user's Speed stat.
Rock Polish.smogon: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages.

Rock Slide.text: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.
Rock Slide.serebii: Has a 30% chance of making targets flinch.
Rock Slide.pokebase: Hurls large boulders at the targets. Has a 30% chance to make them flinch.
Rock Slide.smogon: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch.

Rock Tomb.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.
Rock Tomb.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Rock Tomb.pokebase: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.
Rock Tomb.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Speed by 1 stage.

Rock Wrecker.text: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.
Rock Wrecker.serebii: The user gains the Recharging status on the turn after this move is used.
Rock Wrecker.pokebase: The user launches a huge boulder at the target to attack. The user can't move on the next turn.
Rock Wrecker.smogon: If this move is successful, the user must recharge on the following turn and cannot select a move.

Role Play.text: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
