Role Play.pokebase: The user mimics the target completely, copying the target's Ability.
Role Play.smogon: The user's Ability changes to match the target's Ability. Fails if the user's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, Zero to Hero, or already matches the target, or if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Trace, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Roost.text: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.
Roost.serebii: Restores 1/2 of the user's max HP. If the user is a Flying type it will lose the Flying type for the turn.
Roost.pokebase: The user lands and rests its body. This move restores the user's HP by up to half its max HP.
Roost.smogon: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded half up. If the user is not Terastallized, until the end of the turn Flying-type users lose their Flying type and pure Flying-type users become Normal type. Does nothing if the user's HP is full.

Round.text: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.
Round.serebii: If multiple Pokémon use this move in the same turn the second user onward will act immediately after the first and the power of the second Round onward will be doubled.
Round.pokebase: The user attacks with a song. If an ally also uses Round this turn, they act immediately after the first user, and each consecutive Round doubles in power, up to 240.
Round.smogon: If there are other active Pokemon that chose this move for use this turn, those Pokemon take their turn immediately after the user, in Speed order, and this move's power is 120 for each other user.

Sacred Sword.text: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.
Sacred Sword.serebii: This move ignores the target's stat changes when dealing damage.
Sacred Sword.pokebase: The user attacks by slicing with a sword. The target's stat changes don't affect the damage inflicted by this move.
Sacred Sword.smogon: Ignores the target's stat stage changes, including evasiveness.

Safeguard.text: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.
Safeguard.serebii: Gives the user's side the Safeguard status for 5 turns.
Safeguard.pokebase: The user creates a protective field that prevents status conditions for five turns.
Safeguard.smogon: For 5 turns, the user and its party members cannot have non-volatile status conditions or confusion inflicted on them by other Pokemon. Pokemon on the user's side cannot become affected by Yawn but can fall asleep from its effect. It is removed from the user's side if the user or an ally is successfully hit by Defog. Fails if the effect is already active on the user's side.

Salt Cure.text: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP (1/8 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
Salt Cure.serebii: Gives the target the Salt Cured status.
Salt Cure.pokebase: The user salt cures the target, inflicting damage every turn. Steel and Water types are more strongly affected by this move.
Salt Cure.smogon: Causes damage to the target equal to 1/16 of its maximum HP (1/8 if the target is Steel or Water type), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

Sandstorm.text: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard, Overcoat, Sand Force, Sand Rush, or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.
Sandstorm.pokebase: A five-turn sandstorm is summoned to damage all Pokémon except Rock, Ground, and Steel types. The sandstorm also boosts the Sp. Def stats of Rock types.
Sandstorm.smogon: For 5 turns, the weather becomes Sandstorm. At the end of each turn except the last, all active Pokemon lose 1/16 of their maximum HP, rounded down, unless they are a Ground, Rock, or Steel type, or have the Magic Guard, Overcoat, Sand Force, Sand Rush, or Sand Veil Abilities. During the effect, the Special Defense of Rock-type Pokemon is multiplied by 1.5 when taking damage from a special attack. Lasts for 8 turns if the user is holding Smooth Rock. Fails if the current weather is Sandstorm.

Sand Tomb.text: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.
Sand Tomb.serebii: Gives the target the Bound status.
Sand Tomb.pokebase: The user traps the target inside a harshly raging sandstorm that inflicts damage for four to five turns.
Sand Tomb.smogon: Prevents the target from switching for four or five turns (seven turns if the user is holding Grip Claw). Causes damage to the target equal to 1/8 of its maximum HP (1/6 if the user is holding Binding Band), rounded down, at the end of each turn during effect. The target can still switch out if it is holding Shed Shell or uses Baton Pass, Flip Turn, Parting Shot, Shed Tail, Teleport, U-turn, or Volt Switch. The effect ends if either the user or the target leaves the field, or if the target uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Substitute successfully. This effect is not stackable or reset by using this or another binding move.

Scald.text: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
Scald.serebii: Has a 30% chance of burning the target. Cures the user and target of being frozen.
Scald.pokebase: The user attacks by shooting boiling hot water at the target. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Scald.smogon: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

Scale Shot.text: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Scale Shot.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row. This move lowers the user's Defense stat by 1 stage and boosts its Speed stat by 1 stage.
Scale Shot.pokebase: The user attacks by shooting scales two to five times in a row. This move boosts the user's Speed stat but lowers its Defense stat.
Scale Shot.smogon: Hits two to five times. Lowers the user's Defense by 1 stage and raises the user's Speed by 1 stage after the last hit. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Scary Face.text: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.
Scary Face.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 2 stages.
Scary Face.pokebase: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.
Scary Face.smogon: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages.

Scorching Sands.text: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.
Scorching Sands.serebii: Has a 30% chance of burning the target. Cures the user and target of being frozen.
Scorching Sands.pokebase: The user throws scorching sand at the target to attack. This may also leave the target with a burn.
Scorching Sands.smogon: Has a 30% chance to burn the target. The target thaws out if it is frozen.

Screech.text: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.
Screech.serebii: Lowers the target's Defense stat by 2 stages.
Screech.pokebase: An earsplitting screech harshly lowers the target's Defense stat.
Screech.smogon: Lowers the target's Defense by 2 stages.

Seed Bomb.pokebase: The user attacks by slamming a barrage of hard-shelled seeds down on the target from above.

Seismic Toss.text: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level (50 HP: every Pokemon in Champions is level 50).
Seismic Toss.pokebase: The target is thrown using the power of gravity. It inflicts damage equal to the user's level.
Seismic Toss.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to the user's level.

Self-Destruct.text: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.
Self-Destruct.serebii: The user faints upon using this move.
Self-Destruct.pokebase: The user attacks everything around it by causing an explosion. The user faints upon using this move.
Self-Destruct.smogon: The user faints after using this move, even if this move fails for having no target. This move is prevented from executing if any active Pokemon has the Damp Ability.

Shadow Ball.text: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.
Shadow Ball.serebii: Has a 20% chance of lowering the target's Sp. Def stat by 1 stage.
Shadow Ball.pokebase: Has a 20% chance to lower the target’s Sp. Def by 1 stage.
Shadow Ball.smogon: Has a 20% chance to lower the target's Special Defense by 1 stage.

Shadow Claw.text: Has a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Shadow Claw.serebii: This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Shadow Claw.pokebase: The user attacks by slashing the target with a sharp claw made from shadows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.
Shadow Claw.smogon: Has a higher chance for a critical hit.

Shadow Punch.text: This move does not check accuracy.
Shadow Punch.pokebase: The user throws a punch from the shadows. This attack never misses.
Shadow Punch.smogon: This move does not check accuracy.

Shadow Sneak.pokebase: The user extends its shadow and attacks the target from behind. This move always goes first.

Shed Tail.text: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.
Shed Tail.serebii: The user loses 1/2 of its max HP to create a substitute then switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon. The substitute will be hit by moves instead of that Pokémon and it will vanish when it takes damage equal to 1/4 of the user's max HP.
Shed Tail.pokebase: The user creates a substitute for itself using its own HP before switching places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
Shed Tail.smogon: The user takes 1/2 of its maximum HP, rounded up, and creates a substitute that has 1/4 of the user's maximum HP, rounded down. The user is replaced with another Pokemon in its party and the selected Pokemon has the substitute transferred to it. Fails if the user would faint, or if there are no unfainted party members.

Sheer Cold.text: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.
Sheer Cold.serebii: Knocks out the target. This move does not affect Ice types. The accuracy of this move is fixed at 30%. If used by Pokémon other than Ice types the accuracy of this move is 20%.
Sheer Cold.pokebase: The target faints instantly. This move is less likely to hit the target if used by Pokémon other than Ice types.
Sheer Cold.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to the target's maximum HP. Ignores accuracy and evasiveness modifiers. This attack's accuracy is equal to (user's level - target's level + X)%, where X is 30 if the user is an Ice type and 20 otherwise, and fails if the target is at a higher level. Ice-type Pokemon and Pokemon with the Sturdy Ability are immune.

Shell Side Arm.text: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 × the user's level / 5 + 2) × 90 × X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.
Shell Side Arm.serebii: Has a 20% chance of poisoning the target. Becomes a physical move if that will deal more damage.
Shell Side Arm.pokebase: This move is either physical or special—whichever will inflict more damage. This may also poison the target.
Shell Side Arm.smogon: Has a 20% chance to poison the target. This move becomes a physical attack that makes contact if the value of ((((2 × the user's level / 5 + 2) × 90 × X) / Y) / 50), where X is the user's Attack stat and Y is the target's Defense stat, is greater than the same value where X is the user's Special Attack stat and Y is the target's Special Defense stat. No stat modifiers other than stat stage changes are considered for this purpose. If the two values are equal, this move chooses a damage category at random.

Shell Smash.text: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.
Shell Smash.serebii: Lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats by 1 stage and boosts its Attack Sp. Atk and Speed stats by 2 stages.
Shell Smash.pokebase: The user breaks its shell, which lowers its Defense and Sp. Def stats but sharply boosts its Attack, Sp. Atk, and Speed stats.
Shell Smash.smogon: Lowers the user's Defense and Special Defense by 1 stage. Raises the user's Attack, Special Attack, and Speed by 2 stages.

Shelter.text: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.
Shelter.serebii: Boosts the user's Defense stat by 2 stages.
Shelter.pokebase: The user makes its skin as hard as an iron shield, sharply boosting its Defense stat.
Shelter.smogon: Raises the user's Defense by 2 stages.

Shift Gear.text: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and its Attack by 1 stage.
Shift Gear.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack stat by 1 stage and Speed stat by 2 stages.
Shift Gear.pokebase: Boosts the user’s Attack stat by 1 stage and Speed stat by 2 stages.
Shift Gear.smogon: Raises the user's Speed by 2 stages and its Attack by 1 stage.

Simple Beam.text: Causes the target's Ability to become Simple. Fails if the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Simple, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Truant, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Sing.text: Causes the target to fall asleep.
Sing.pokebase: A soothing lullaby is sung in a beautiful voice that puts the target to sleep.
Sing.smogon: Causes the target to fall asleep.

Skill Swap.text: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Fails if either the user or the target's Ability is As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
Skill Swap.serebii: The user and the target swap their Abilities.
Skill Swap.pokebase: The user employs its psychic power to exchange Abilities with the target.
Skill Swap.smogon: The user swaps its Ability with the target's Ability. Skitter Smack.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Sky Attack.text: Has a 30% chance to make the target flinch and a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move). This attack charges on the first turn and executes on the second. If the user is holding a Power Herb, the move completes in one turn.
Sky Attack.serebii: The user gains the Charging status on the turn this move is used then attacks on the following turn. This move has a 30% chance of making the target flinch and it has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Sky Attack.pokebase: The user attacks the turn after using this move. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also make the target flinch.

Sleep Powder.text: Causes the target to fall asleep.
Sleep Powder.pokebase: Puts the target to sleep. Grass-type Pokémon are unaffected.

The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. This move cannot select Assist, Beak Blast, Belch, Bide, Blazing Torque, Celebrate, Chatter, Combat Torque, Copycat, Dynamax Cannon, Focus Punch, Hold Hands, Magical Torque, Me First, Metronome, Mimic, Mirror Move, Nature Power, Noxious Torque, Shell Trap, Sketch, Sleep Talk, Struggle, Uproar, Wicked Torque, or any two-turn move.

Sleep Talk.pokebase: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.
Sleep Talk.smogon: One of the user's known moves, besides this move, is selected for use at random. Fails if the user is not asleep. The selected move does not have PP deducted from it, and can currently have 0 PP. Sludge Wave.text: Has a 10% chance to poison the target.
Sludge Wave.serebii: Has a 10% chance of poisoning targets.

Smack Down.text: This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If this move hits a target under the effect of Bounce, Fly, Magnet Rise, or Telekinesis, the effect ends. Substitute.text: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. The substitute is removed once enough damage is inflicted on it, if the user switches out or faints, or if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up. Baton Pass can be used to transfer the substitute to an ally, and the substitute will keep its remaining HP. Until the substitute is broken, it receives damage from all attacks made by other Pokemon and shields the user from status effects and stat stage changes caused by other Pokemon. Sound-based moves and Pokemon with the Infiltrator Ability ignore substitutes. The user still takes normal damage from weather and status effects while behind its substitute. If the substitute breaks during a multi-hit attack, the user will take damage from any remaining hits. If a substitute is created while the user is trapped by a binding move, the binding effect ends immediately. Fails if the user does not have enough HP remaining to create a substitute without fainting, or if it already has a substitute.

Substitute.pokebase: The user loses 1/4 of its max HP to create a substitute. The substitute will be hit by moves instead of the user, and it will vanish when it takes damage equal to 1/4 of the user's max HP. Sound-based moves will hit the user through the substitute.
Substitute.smogon: The user takes 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, and puts it into a substitute to take its place in battle. Super Fang.text: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.
Super Fang.serebii: Deals damage to the target equal to 1/2 of its remaining HP. Deals 1 HP of damage to a target that has only 1 HP left.
Super Fang.pokebase: The user chomps hard on the target with its sharp front fangs. This cuts the target's HP in half.
Super Fang.smogon: Deals damage to the target equal to half of its current HP, rounded down, but not less than 1 HP.

Superpower.text: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
Superpower.serebii: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Superpower.pokebase: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.
Superpower.smogon: Lowers the user's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

Surf.text: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.
Surf.serebii: This move's power is doubled against targets that have the Submerged status.
Surf.pokebase: The user attacks everything around it by swamping its surroundings with a giant wave.
Surf.smogon: Damage doubles if the target is using Dive.

Swagger.text: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.
Swagger.serebii: Boosts the target's Attack stat by 2 stages and confuses it.
Swagger.pokebase: The user enrages and confuses the target. However, this also sharply boosts the target's Attack stat.
Swagger.smogon: Raises the target's Attack by 2 stages and confuses it.

Swallow.text: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.
Swallow.serebii: The higher the user's Stockpiling level the more HP the user restores. Level 1 1/4 of the user's max HP is restored. Level 2 1/2 of the user's max HP is restored. Level 3 The user's HP is fully restored. This move fails unless the user has the Stockpiling status.
Swallow.pokebase: The power stored using the move Stockpile is absorbed by the user to restore its own HP. The more power is stored, the more HP is restored.
Swallow.smogon: The user restores its HP based on its Stockpile count. Restores 1/4 of its maximum HP if it's 1, 1/2 of its maximum HP if it's 2, both rounded half down, and all of its HP if it's 3. Fails if the user's Stockpile count is 0. The user's Defense and Special Defense decrease by as many stages as Stockpile had increased them, and the user's Stockpile count resets to 0.

Sweet Kiss.text: Causes the target to become confused.
Sweet Kiss.pokebase: The user kisses the target with a sweet, angelic cuteness that causes confusion.
Sweet Kiss.smogon: Causes the target to become confused.

Sweet Scent.text: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.
Sweet Scent.pokebase: The user releases a scent that harshly lowers opposing Pokémon's evasiveness.
Sweet Scent.smogon: Lowers the target's evasiveness by 2 stages.

Switcheroo.text: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
Switcheroo.serebii: The user and the target swap their held items.
Switcheroo.pokebase: The user trades held items with the target faster than the eye can follow.
Switcheroo.smogon: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

Swords Dance.text: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.
Swords Dance.serebii: Boosts the user's Attack stat by 2 stages.
Swords Dance.pokebase: A frenetic dance to uplift the fighting spirit. This sharply boosts the user's Attack stat.
Swords Dance.smogon: Raises the user's Attack by 2 stages.

Synthesis.text: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.
Synthesis.serebii: Restores 1/2 of the user's max HP. In harsh sunlight 2/3 of its max HP will be restored instead. In all other weather conditions 1/4 of its max HP will be restored instead.
Synthesis.pokebase: The user restores its own HP. The amount of HP regained varies with the weather.
Synthesis.smogon: The user restores 1/2 of its maximum HP if Strong Winds or no weather conditions are in effect or if the user is holding Utility Umbrella, 2/3 of its maximum HP if the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, and 1/4 of its maximum HP if the weather is Heavy Rain, Rain, Sandstorm, or Snow, all rounded half down.

Syrup Bomb.text: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.
Syrup Bomb.serebii: Gives the target the Syrupy status for 3 turns.
Syrup Bomb.pokebase: The user sets off an explosion of sticky candy syrup, which coats the target and causes the target's Speed stat to drop each turn for three turns.
Syrup Bomb.smogon: If this move is successful, it causes the target's Speed to be lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn for 3 turns.

Tail Slap.text: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.
Tail Slap.serebii: The user attacks 2 to 5 times in a row.
Tail Slap.pokebase: The user attacks by striking the target with its hard tail. This move hits two to five times in a row.
Tail Slap.smogon: Hits two to five times. Has a 35% chance to hit two or three times and a 15% chance to hit four or five times. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit five times. If the user is holding Loaded Dice, this move will hit 4-5 times.

Tailwind.text: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.
Tailwind.serebii: Gives the user's side the Tailwind status for 4 turns.
Tailwind.pokebase: The user whips up a turbulent whirlwind that doubles the Speed stats of itself and its allies for four turns.
Tailwind.smogon: For 4 turns, the user and its party members have their Speed doubled. Fails if this move is already in effect for the user's side.

Taunt.text: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.
Taunt.serebii: Gives the target the Taunted status.
Taunt.pokebase: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.
Taunt.smogon: Prevents the target from using non-damaging moves for its next three turns. Pokemon with the Oblivious Ability or protected by the Aroma Veil Ability are immune.

Tearful Look.text: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.
Tearful Look.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats by 1 stage. This move ignores the target's evasiveness and can hit a target using a move such as Protect.
Tearful Look.pokebase: The user gets teary-eyed to make the target lose its combative spirit. This lowers the target's Attack and Sp. Atk stats.
Tearful Look.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack and Special Attack by 1 stage.

Teatime.text: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.
Teatime.serebii: Causes all Pokémon on the field to eat their held Berries.
Teatime.pokebase: The user has teatime with all the Pokémon currently in the battle. Each Pokémon eats its held Berry.
Teatime.smogon: All active Pokemon consume their held Berries. This effect is not prevented by substitutes, the Klutz or Unnerve Abilities, or the effects of Embargo or Magic Room. Fails if no active Pokemon is holding a Berry.

Teeter Dance.text: Causes the target to become confused.
Teeter Dance.serebii: Confuses all other Pokémon on the field.
Teeter Dance.pokebase: The user performs a wobbly dance that confuses every Pokémon around it.
Teeter Dance.smogon: Causes the target to become confused.

Temper Flare.text: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.
Temper Flare.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the user couldn't act or its move missed or failed on the previous turn.
Temper Flare.pokebase: Spurred by desperation, the user attacks the target. This move's power is doubled if the user's previous move failed.
Temper Flare.smogon: Power doubles if the user's last move on the previous turn, including moves called by other moves or those used through Instruct, Magic Coat, Snatch, or the Dancer or Magic Bounce Abilities, failed to do any of its normal effects, not including damage from an unsuccessful High Jump Kick, Jump Kick, or Mind Blown, or if the user was prevented from moving by any effect other than recharging or Sky Drop. A move that was blocked by Baneful Bunker, Detect, King's Shield, Protect, Spiky Shield, Crafty Shield, Mat Block, Quick Guard, or Wide Guard will not double this move's power, nor will Bounce or Fly ending early due to the effect of Gravity, Smack Down, or Thousand Arrows.

Terrain Pulse.text: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.
Terrain Pulse.serebii: This move's power is doubled if the user is under the effect of a terrain. This move's type depends on the terrain.
Terrain Pulse.pokebase: The user utilizes the energy of the terrain to attack. This move’s type and power change depending on the terrain at the time the move is used.
Terrain Pulse.smogon: Power doubles if the user is grounded and a terrain is active, and this move's type changes to match. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain.

Thief.text: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.
Thief.serebii: If the user is not already holding an item it steals the target's held item.
Thief.pokebase: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.
Thief.smogon: If this attack was successful and the user is not holding an item, it steals the target's held item. A target with the Sticky Hold Ability does not lose its held item if it has not fainted. The target's item is not stolen if it is a Mega Stone and either the user or the target is the species that can Mega Evolve with it. Items lost to this move cannot be regained with Recycle or the Harvest Ability.

Thrash.text: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.
Thrash.serebii: The user gains the Rampaging status.
Thrash.pokebase: The user rampages and attacks for two to three turns. The user then becomes confused.
Thrash.smogon: The user spends two or three turns locked into this move and becomes confused immediately after its move on the last turn of the effect if it is not already. This move targets an opposing Pokemon at random on each turn. If the user is prevented from moving, is asleep at the beginning of a turn, or the attack is not successful against the target on the first turn of the effect or the second turn of a three-turn effect, the effect ends without causing confusion. If this move is called by Sleep Talk and the user is asleep, the move is used for one turn and does not confuse the user.

Throat Chop.text: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.
Throat Chop.serebii: Gives the target the Throat Chopped status.
Throat Chop.pokebase: The user attacks the target's throat, and the resultant suffering prevents the target from using sound-based moves for two turns.
Throat Chop.smogon: For 2 turns, the target cannot use sound-based moves.

Thunder.text: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.
Thunder.serebii: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. This move never misses in rain and can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.
Thunder.pokebase: Has a 30% chance of paralyzing the target. In rain, this move never misses. In harsh sunlight, this move's accuracy is 50%. This move can hit a target that has the Sky-High status.
Thunder.smogon: Has a 30% chance to paralyze the target. This move can hit a target using Bounce, Fly, or Sky Drop, or is under the effect of Sky Drop. If the weather is Heavy Rain or Rain, this move does not check accuracy. If the weather is Intense Sun or Sun, this move's accuracy is 50%. If this move is used against a Pokemon holding Utility Umbrella, this move's accuracy remains at 70%.

Thunderbolt.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunderbolt.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.
Thunderbolt.pokebase: The user attacks the target with a strong electric blast. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunderbolt.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

Thunder Fang.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.
Thunder Fang.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target and a 10% chance of making the target flinch.
Thunder Fang.pokebase: The user bites with electrified fangs. This may also make the target flinch or leave it with paralysis.
Thunder Fang.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target and a 10% chance to make it flinch.

Thunder Punch.text: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.
Thunder Punch.serebii: Has a 10% chance of paralyzing the target.
Thunder Punch.pokebase: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.
Thunder Punch.smogon: Has a 10% chance to paralyze the target.

Thunder Wave.text: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.
Thunder Wave.pokebase: Paralyzes the target. Ground-type Pokémon are unaffected.
Thunder Wave.smogon: Paralyzes the target. This move does not ignore type immunity.

Tickle.text: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.
Tickle.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense stats by 1 stage.
Tickle.pokebase: The user tickles the target into laughing, lowering its Attack and Defense stats.
Tickle.smogon: Lowers the target's Attack and Defense by 1 stage.

Tidy Up.text: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.
Tidy Up.serebii: Removes the Sticky Web Stealth Rock Substitute Spikes and Toxic Spikes statuses from the entire field. Boosts the user's Attack and Speed stats by 1 stage.
Tidy Up.pokebase: The user tidies up and removes the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, Toxic Spikes, and Substitute. This also boosts the user’s Attack and Speed stats.
Tidy Up.smogon: Raises the user's Attack and Speed by 1 stage. Removes substitutes from all active Pokemon and ends the effects of Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes for both sides.

Topsy-Turvy.text: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.
Topsy-Turvy.serebii: Inverts all stat changes affecting the target.
Topsy-Turvy.pokebase: All stat changes affecting the target turn topsy-turvy and become the opposite of what they were.
Topsy-Turvy.smogon: The target's positive stat stages become negative and vice versa. Fails if all of the target's stat stages are 0.

Torch Song.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.
Torch Song.serebii: Boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat by 1 stage.
Torch Song.pokebase: The user blows out raging flames as if singing a song, scorching the target. This also boosts the user's Sp. Atk stat.
Torch Song.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Special Attack by 1 stage.

Torment.text: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.
Torment.serebii: Gives the target the Unable to Repeat status.
Torment.pokebase: The user torments and enrages the target, making it incapable of using the same move twice in a row.
Torment.smogon: Prevents the target from selecting the same move for use two turns in a row. This effect ends when the target is no longer active.

Toxic.text: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.
Toxic.serebii: Badly poisons the target. If the user is a Poison type this move will never miss.
Toxic.pokebase: A move that leaves the target badly poisoned. Its poison damage worsens every turn.
Toxic.smogon: Badly poisons the target. If a Poison-type Pokemon uses this move, the target cannot avoid the attack, even if the target is in the middle of a two-turn move.

Toxic Spikes.text: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.
Toxic Spikes.serebii: Gives the opponent's side the Toxic Spikes status.
Toxic Spikes.pokebase: The user lays a trap of poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team. The spikes will poison opposing Pokémon that switch into battle.
Toxic Spikes.smogon: Sets up a hazard on the opposing side of the field, poisoning each opposing Pokemon that switches in, unless it is a Flying-type Pokemon or has the Levitate Ability. Can be used up to two times before failing. Opposing Pokemon become poisoned with one layer and badly poisoned with two layers. Can be removed from the opposing side if any Pokemon uses Tidy Up, or if any opposing Pokemon uses Mortal Spin, Rapid Spin, or Defog successfully, is hit by Defog, or a grounded Poison-type Pokemon switches in. Safeguard prevents the opposing party from being poisoned on switch-in, but a substitute does not.

Toxic Thread.text: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.
Toxic Thread.serebii: Lowers the target's Speed stat by 2 stages and poisons it.
Toxic Thread.pokebase: Inflicts Poison. Lowers opponent's Speed by 2 stages.
Toxic Thread.smogon: Lowers the target's Speed by 2 stages and poisons it.

Trailblaze.text: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.
Trailblaze.serebii: Boosts the user's Speed stat by 1 stage.
Trailblaze.pokebase: The user attacks suddenly as if leaping out from tall grass. The user's nimble footwork boosts its Speed stat.
Trailblaze.smogon: Has a 100% chance to raise the user's Speed by 1 stage.

Transform.text: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.
Transform.serebii: The user transforms into a copy of the target. It also copies all of the target's stats apart from its HP.
Transform.pokebase: The user transforms into a copy of the target, right down to having the same move set.
Transform.smogon: The user transforms into the target. The target's current stats, stat stages, types, moves, Ability, weight, gender, and sprite are copied. The user's level and HP remain the same and each copied move receives only 5 PP, with a maximum of 5 PP each. The user can no longer change formes if it would have the ability to do so. This move fails if it hits a substitute, if either the user or the target is already transformed, or if either is behind an Illusion.

Tri Attack.text: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
Tri Attack.serebii: Has a 20% chance of leaving the target burned frozen or paralyzed.
Tri Attack.pokebase: The user strikes with a simultaneous three-beam attack. This may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.
Tri Attack.smogon: Has a 20% chance to either burn, freeze, or paralyze the target.

Trick-or-Treat.text: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.
Trick-or-Treat.serebii: Gives the target the Trick-or-Treating status.
Trick-or-Treat.pokebase: The user takes the target trick-or-treating. This adds Ghost type to the target’s type.
Trick-or-Treat.smogon: Causes the Ghost type to be added to the target, effectively making it have two or three types. Fails if the target is already a Ghost type. If Forest's Curse adds a type to the target, it replaces the type added by this move and vice versa.

Trick.text: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.
Trick.serebii: The user and the target swap their held items.
Trick.pokebase: The user catches the target off guard and swaps the target's held item with its own.
Trick.smogon: The user swaps its held item with the target's held item. Fails if both the user and the target have no held item, or if the user is trying to give or take a Mega Stone to or from the species that can Mega Evolve with it. The target is immune to this move if it has the Sticky Hold Ability.

Trick Room.text: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.
Trick Room.serebii: Gives the entire field the Trick Room status for 5 turns.
Trick Room.pokebase: The user creates a bizarre area in which slower Pokémon get to move first for five turns.
Trick Room.smogon: For 5 turns, the Speed of every Pokemon is recalculated for the purposes of determining turn order. During the effect, each Pokemon's Speed is considered to be (10000 - its normal Speed), and if this value is greater than 8191, 8192 is subtracted from it. If this move is used during the effect, the effect ends.

Triple Arrows.text: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit (12.5%, against 4.17% for a normal move).
Triple Arrows.serebii: Has a 50% chance of lowering the target's Defense stat by 1 stage and has a 30% chance of making the target flinch. This move has a 1-stage Critical-Hit Ratio Boost.
Triple Arrows.pokebase: The user kicks, then fires three arrows. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit and may also lower the target’s Defense stat or make it flinch.
Triple Arrows.smogon: Has a 50% chance to lower the target's Defense by 1 stage, a 30% chance to make it flinch, and a higher chance for a critical hit.

Triple Axel.text: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.
Triple Axel.serebii: The user attacks 3 times in a row—first with a power of 20 then with a power of 40 then with a power of 60. The attack ends if the user misses.
Triple Axel.pokebase: A consecutive three-kick attack that becomes more powerful with each successful hit.
Triple Axel.smogon: Hits three times. Power increases to 40 for the second hit and 60 for the third. This move checks accuracy for each hit, and the attack ends if the target avoids a hit. If one of the hits breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the remaining hits. If the user has the Skill Link Ability, this move will always hit three times.

Trop Kick.text: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.
Trop Kick.serebii: Lowers the target's Attack stat by 1 stage.
Trop Kick.pokebase: The user lands an intense kick of tropical origins on the target. This also lowers the target's Attack stat.
Trop Kick.smogon: Has a 100% chance to lower the target's Attack by 1 stage.

Twin Beam.text: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.
Twin Beam.serebii: The user attacks twice in a row.
Twin Beam.pokebase: The user shoots mystical beams from its eyes to inflict damage. The target is hit twice in a row.
Twin Beam.smogon: Hits twice. If the first hit breaks the target's substitute, it will take damage for the second hit.

U-turn.text: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.
U-turn.serebii: After attacking the user switches out of battle to be replaced by another party Pokémon.
U-turn.pokebase: After making its attack, the user rushes back to switch places with a party Pokémon in waiting.
U-turn.smogon: If this move is successful and the user has not fainted, the user switches out even if it is trapped and is replaced immediately by a selected party member. The user does not switch out if there are no unfainted party members, or if the target switched out using an Eject Button or through the effect of the Emergency Exit or Wimp Out Abilities.

Upper Hand.text: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.
Upper Hand.serebii: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority move.
Upper Hand.pokebase: Makes the target flinch. This move fails if the target isn't about to use a priority attack.
Upper Hand.smogon: Has a 100% chance to make the target flinch. Fails if the target did not select a physical or special attack for use this turn with altered priority greater than 0, or if the target moves before the user.

Uproar.text: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.
Uproar.serebii: The user gains the Uproar status.
Uproar.pokebase: The user attacks in an uproar for three turns. During that time, no Pokémon can fall asleep.
Uproar.smogon: The user spends three turns locked into this move. This move targets an opponent at random on each turn. On the first of the three turns, all sleeping active Pokemon wake up. During the three turns, no active Pokemon can fall asleep by any means, and Pokemon switched in during the effect do not wake up. If the user is prevented from moving or the attack is not successful against the target during one of the turns, the effect ends.

Disguise.text: If this Pokemon is a Mimikyu, the first hit it takes in battle deals 0 neutral damage. Its disguise is then broken, it changes to Busted Form, and it loses 1/8 of its max HP. Confusion damage also breaks the disguise.

Dry Skin.text: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move. The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. The weather effects are prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Dry Skin.pokebase: Restores the Pokémon's HP in rain or when it is hit by Water-type moves. Reduces HP in harsh sunlight, and increases the damage received from Fire-type moves.

The power of Fire-type moves is multiplied by 1.25 when used on this Pokemon. At the end of each turn, this Pokemon restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Rain, and loses 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, if the weather is Sun. Early Bird.text: This Pokemon's sleep counter drops by 2 instead of 1.
Early Bird.serebii: Sleep conditions lasts for half as long, rounding down. For example, half of three turns is 1.5, which rounds down to one turn. When the number of turns to sleep is one, half of this rounded down is zero, and the Pokémon wakes up instantly.
Early Bird.pokebase: The Pokémon awakens from sleep twice as fast as other Pokémon.

Eelevate.text: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability. Emergency Exit.text: When this Pokemon has more than 1/2 its maximum HP and takes damage bringing it to 1/2 or less of its maximum HP, it immediately switches out to a chosen ally.
