Leaf Guard.pokebase: Prevents status conditions in harsh sunlight.
Leaf Guard.smogon: If Sun is active, this Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn, and Rest will fail for it. This effect is prevented if this Pokemon is holding a Utility Umbrella.

Levitate.text: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.
Levitate.serebii: Damage dealing Ground-type moves have no effect on this Pokémon. Cannot be trapped by Arena Trap ability. Takes no damage from Spikes.
Levitate.pokebase: Damage dealing Ground-type moves have no effect on this Pokémon. Cannot be trapped by Arena Trap ability. Takes no damage from Spikes.
Levitate.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Ground-type attacks and the effects of Spikes, Toxic Spikes, Sticky Web, and the Arena Trap Ability. The effects of Gravity, Ingrain, Smack Down, Thousand Arrows, and Iron Ball nullify the immunity. Thousand Arrows can hit this Pokemon as if it did not have this Ability.

Libero.text: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
Libero.serebii: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.
Libero.pokebase: Changes the Pokémon's type to the type of the move it's about to use. This works only once per time the Pokémon enters battle.
Libero.smogon: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Light Metal.text: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.
Light Metal.smogon: This Pokemon's weight is halved, rounded down to a tenth of a kilogram. This effect is calculated after the effect of Autotomize, and before the effect of Float Stone. A Pokemon's weight will not drop below 0.1 kg.

Lightning Rod.text: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.
Lightning Rod.serebii: Electric-type moves are drawn to this Pokémon. Electric-type moves will do no damage and the Pokémon's SP ATK is raised one stage.
Lightning Rod.pokebase: The Pokémon draws in all Electric-type moves. Instead of taking damage from them, its Sp. Atk stat is boosted.
Lightning Rod.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Special Attack by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move. If this Pokemon is not the target of a single-target Electric-type move used by another Pokemon, this Pokemon redirects that move to itself if it is within the range of that move. If multiple Pokemon could redirect with this Ability, it goes to the one with the highest Speed, or in the case of a tie to the one that has had this Ability active longer.

Limber.text: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.
Limber.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be Paralysed while having this ability.
Limber.pokebase: The Pokémon's limber body prevents it from being paralyzed.
Limber.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be paralyzed. Gaining this Ability while paralyzed cures it.

Liquid Ooze.text: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.
Liquid Ooze.serebii: When the opponent absorbs Hit Points from this Pokémon, the opponent instead loses Hit Points.
Liquid Ooze.pokebase: When the Pokémon is hit by an HP-absorbing move, the attacker does not restore HP but instead takes damage equal to the amount of HP it would have restored.
Liquid Ooze.smogon: This Pokemon damages those draining HP from it for as much as they would heal.

Liquid Voice.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
Liquid Voice.serebii: All sound-based moves become Water-type moves.
Liquid Voice.smogon: This Pokemon's sound-based moves become Water-type moves. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Long Reach.text: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.
Long Reach.serebii: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
Long Reach.pokebase: The Pokémon uses its moves without making contact with the target.
Long Reach.smogon: This Pokemon's attacks do not make contact with the target.

Magic Bounce.text: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.
Magic Bounce.serebii: Reflects non-attacking moves used on the Pokémon back to the attacking Pokémon
Magic Bounce.pokebase: Reflects non-attacking moves used on the Pokémon back to the attacking Pokémon
Magic Bounce.smogon: This Pokemon is unaffected by certain non-damaging moves directed at it and will instead use such moves against the original user. Moves reflected in this way are unable to be reflected again by this or Magic Coat's effect. Spikes, Stealth Rock, Sticky Web, and Toxic Spikes can only be reflected once per side, by the leftmost Pokemon under this or Magic Coat's effect. The Lightning Rod and Storm Drain Abilities redirect their respective moves before this Ability takes effect.

Magic Guard.text: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.
Magic Guard.serebii: Prevents all no damage except from direct-attack moves, excluding damage self inflicted from Substitute, Belly Drum, Curse & Pain Split.
Magic Guard.pokebase: The Pokémon only takes damage from attacks.
Magic Guard.smogon: This Pokemon can only be damaged by direct attacks. Curse and Substitute on use, Belly Drum, Pain Split, Struggle recoil, and confusion damage are considered direct damage.

Magician.text: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.
Magician.serebii: The Pokémon steals the held item of a Pokémon it hits with a move.
Magician.pokebase: The Pokémon steals the held item from any target it hits with a move.
Magician.smogon: If this Pokemon has no item, it steals the item off a Pokemon it hits with an attack. Does not affect Doom Desire and Future Sight. If multiple targets are hit by an attack the item is stolen from the fastest Pokemon, while considering the effect of Trick Room and prioritizing opposing Pokemon before allies.

Magma Armor.text: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.
Magma Armor.serebii: This Pokémon cannot be Frozen while having this ability.
Magma Armor.pokebase: The Pokémon’s hot magma coating prevents it from being frozen.
Magma Armor.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be frozen. Gaining this Ability while frozen cures it.

Marvel Scale.text: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.
Marvel Scale.serebii: Defense is increased by 50% when induced with a status (BURN, PARALYZE, SLEEP, POISON, FREEZE).
Marvel Scale.pokebase: The Pokémon's marvelous scales boost its Defense stat if it has a status condition.
Marvel Scale.smogon: If this Pokemon has a non-volatile status condition, its Defense is multiplied by 1.5.

Mega Launcher.text: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.
Mega Launcher.serebii: Increases the power of Aura and Pulse moves by 50%
Mega Launcher.smogon: This Pokemon's pulse moves have their power multiplied by 1.5. Heal Pulse restores 3/4 of a target's maximum HP, rounded half down.

Mega Sol.text: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.
Mega Sol.serebii: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
Mega Sol.pokebase: Even when the sunlight has not turned harsh, the Pokémon can use its moves as if the weather were harsh sunlight.
Mega Sol.smogon: This Pokemon's moves are used as if the effects of Sun were active.

Merciless.text: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.
Merciless.serebii: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
Merciless.pokebase: The Pokémon's attacks become critical hits if the target is poisoned.
Merciless.smogon: This Pokemon's attacks are critical hits if the target is poisoned.

Mimicry.text: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.
Mimicry.serebii: Changes to Electric-type in Electric Terrain, Psychic-type in Psychic Terrain, Grass-type in Grassy Terrain and Fairy type in Fairy-terrain. The type reverts to normal when the terrain ends.
Mimicry.pokebase: Changes the Pokémon’s type depending on the terrain.
Mimicry.smogon: This Pokemon's types change to match the active Terrain when this Pokemon acquires this Ability, or whenever a Terrain begins. Electric type during Electric Terrain, Grass type during Grassy Terrain, Fairy type during Misty Terrain, and Psychic type during Psychic Terrain. If this Ability is acquired without an active Terrain, or a Terrain ends, this Pokemon's types become the original types for its species.

Minus.text: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
Minus.serebii: When battling with Plus or Minus, Special Attack increases by 50%.
Minus.pokebase: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Minus.smogon: If an active ally has this Ability or the Plus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Mirror Armor.text: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.
Mirror Armor.serebii: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
Mirror Armor.pokebase: Bounces back only the stat-lowering effects that the Pokémon receives.
Mirror Armor.smogon: When one of this Pokemon's stat stages would be lowered by another Pokemon, that Pokemon's stat stage is lowered instead. This effect does not happen if this Pokemon's stat stage was already -6. If the other Pokemon has a substitute, neither Pokemon has its stat stage lowered.

Mold Breaker.text: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.
Mold Breaker.serebii: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle
Mold Breaker.pokebase: The Pokémon's moves are not affected by foe’s abilities during battle
Mold Breaker.smogon: This Pokemon's moves and their effects ignore certain Abilities of other Pokemon. The Abilities that can be negated are Armor Tail, Aroma Veil, Aura Break, Battle Armor, Big Pecks, Bulletproof, Clear Body, Contrary, Damp, Dazzling, Disguise, Dry Skin, Earth Eater, Filter, Flash Fire, Flower Gift, Flower Veil, Fluffy, Friend Guard, Fur Coat, Good as Gold, Grass Pelt, Guard Dog, Heatproof, Heavy Metal, Hyper Cutter, Ice Face, Ice Scales, Illuminate, Immunity, Inner Focus, Insomnia, Keen Eye, Leaf Guard, Levitate, Light Metal, Lightning Rod, Limber, Magic Bounce, Magma Armor, Marvel Scale, Mind's Eye, Mirror Armor, Motor Drive, Multiscale, Oblivious, Overcoat, Own Tempo, Pastel Veil, Punk Rock, Purifying Salt, Queenly Majesty, Sand Veil, Sap Sipper, Shell Armor, Shield Dust, Simple, Snow Cloak, Solid Rock, Soundproof, Sticky Hold, Storm Drain, Sturdy, Suction Cups, Sweet Veil, Tangled Feet, Telepathy, Tera Shell, Thermal Exchange, Thick Fat, Unaware, Vital Spirit, Volt Absorb, Water Absorb, Water Bubble, Water Veil, Well-Baked Body, White Smoke, Wind Rider, Wonder Guard, and Wonder Skin. This affects every other Pokemon on the field, whether or not it is a target of this Pokemon's move, and whether or not their Ability is beneficial to this Pokemon.

Moody.text: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.
Moody.serebii: At the end of every turn, a random stat (except Accuracy and Evasion) is raised by two stages while another is lowered by one stage.
Moody.pokebase: Every turn, one of the Pokémon's stats will be boosted sharply but another stat will be lowered.
Moody.smogon: This Pokemon has a random stat, other than accuracy or evasiveness, raised by 2 stages and another stat lowered by 1 stage at the end of each turn.

Motor Drive.text: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.
Motor Drive.serebii: The Pokémon takes no damage from Electric-type attacks and Speed raises by one level.
Motor Drive.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage when hit by Electric-type moves. Instead, its Speed stat is boosted.
Motor Drive.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and raises its Speed by 1 stage when hit by an Electric-type move.

Moxie.text: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.
Moxie.serebii: Attack is raised by one stage when the Pokémon knocks out another Pokémon
Moxie.pokebase: When the Pokémon knocks out a target, it shows moxie, which boosts its Attack stat.
Moxie.smogon: This Pokemon's Attack is raised by 1 stage if it attacks and knocks out another Pokemon.

Multiscale.text: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.
Multiscale.serebii: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP
Multiscale.pokebase: Reduces damage afflicted to the Pokémon by 50% if at maximum HP
Multiscale.smogon: If this Pokemon is at full HP, damage taken from attacks is halved.

Mummy.text: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.
Mummy.serebii: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker's Ability to Mummy.
Mummy.pokebase: Contact with the Pokémon changes the attacker’s Ability to Mummy.
Mummy.smogon: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability changed to Mummy. Does not affect Pokemon with the As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Disguise, Gulp Missile, Ice Face, Multitype, Mummy, Power Construct, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shift, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero Abilities.

Natural Cure.text: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.
Natural Cure.serebii: The Pokémon’s status (BURN, PARALYZE, SLEEP, POISON, FREEZE) is healed when withdrawn from battle.
Natural Cure.pokebase: The Pokémon's status conditions are cured when it switches out.
Natural Cure.smogon: This Pokemon has its non-volatile status condition cured when it switches out.

No Guard.text: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.
No Guard.serebii: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%
No Guard.pokebase: The accuracy of all moves known by this Pokémon and all Pokémon targeting this Pokémon raises to 100%
No Guard.smogon: Every move used by or against this Pokemon will always hit.

Oblivious.text: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Oblivious.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be under the Attract condition, Intimidated, or be taunted, while having this ability.
Oblivious.pokebase: The Pokémon is oblivious, keeping it from being infatuated, falling for taunts, or being affected by Intimidate.
Oblivious.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be infatuated or taunted. Gaining this Ability while infatuated or taunted cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Opportunist.text: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.
Opportunist.serebii: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Opportunist.pokebase: If an opponent's stat is boosted, the Pokémon seizes the opportunity to boost the same stat for itself.
Opportunist.smogon: When an opposing Pokemon has a stat stage raised, this Pokemon copies the effect.

Overcoat.text: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.
Overcoat.serebii: Protects Pokémon from Weather Effects and Powder moves such as Sleep Powder, Poison Powder etc.
Overcoat.pokebase: The Pokémon takes no damage from sandstorms. It is also protected from the effects of powders and spores.
Overcoat.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to powder moves, damage from Sandstorm, and the effects of Rage Powder and the Effect Spore Ability.

Overgrow.text: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.
Overgrow.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Grass-type moves is increased by 50%.
Overgrow.pokebase: Powers up Grass-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Overgrow.smogon: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Grass-type attack.

Own Tempo.text: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.
Own Tempo.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be Confused while having this ability. Blocks Intimidate
Own Tempo.pokebase: The Pokémon sticks to its own tempo, preventing it from becoming confused or being affected by Intimidate.
Own Tempo.smogon: This Pokemon cannot be confused. Gaining this Ability while confused cures it. This Pokemon is immune to the effect of the Intimidate Ability.

Parental Bond.text: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.
Parental Bond.serebii: Every move used by the Pokémon will hit twice. The damage inflicted by the second hit is reduced to 25%. If the move used is a damaging move, each hit is capable of afflicting Secondary Effects and Critical Hits
Parental Bond.smogon: This Pokemon's damaging moves become multi-hit moves that hit twice. The second hit has its damage quartered. Does not affect Doom Desire, Dragon Darts, Dynamax Cannon, Endeavor, Explosion, Final Gambit, Fling, Future Sight, Ice Ball, Rollout, Self-Destruct, any multi-hit move, any move that has multiple targets, or any two-turn move.

Pickpocket.text: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.
Pickpocket.serebii: When a Pokémon makes physical contact with the Pokémon, the item of the opponent is stolen.
Pickpocket.pokebase: The Pokémon steals the held item from attackers that made direct contact with it.
Pickpocket.smogon: If this Pokemon has no item and is hit by a contact move, it steals the attacker's item. This effect applies after all hits from a multi-hit move. This effect is prevented if the move had a secondary effect removed by the Sheer Force Ability.

Pickup.text: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.
Pickup.serebii: Has a 10% chance of finding and holding an item after battle. Will not work if this Pokémon is already holding an item. From Black & White, it allows for the user to pick up the item of its opponent or ally if they used up the item in battle.
Pickup.pokebase: The Pokémon may pick up an item another Pokémon used during a battle. It may pick up items outside of battle, too.
Pickup.smogon: At the end of each turn, if this Pokemon is not holding an item and at least one adjacent Pokemon used an item during this turn, one of those Pokemon is selected at random and this Pokemon obtains that Pokemon's last used item. An item is not considered the last used if it was a popped Air Balloon, if the item was picked up by another Pokemon with this Ability, or if the item was lost to Bug Bite, Corrosive Gas, Covet, Incinerate, Knock Off, Pluck, or Thief. Items thrown with Fling can be picked up.

Piercing Drill.text: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
Piercing Drill.serebii: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Piercing Drill.pokebase: When the Pokémon uses contact moves, it can hit even targets that are protecting themselves, dealing 1/4 of the damage that the move would otherwise deal. Everything aside from the target's protective effects is still triggered.
Piercing Drill.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

Pixilate.text: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.
Pixilate.serebii: Increases the power of Normal-type moves by 20%. It then changes those moves to Fairy-type.
Pixilate.pokebase: Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves. The power of those moves is boosted a little.
Pixilate.smogon: This Pokemon's Normal-type moves become Fairy-type moves and have their power multiplied by 1.2. This effect comes after other effects that change a move's type, but before Ion Deluge and Electrify's effects.

Plus.text: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.
Plus.serebii: When battling with Plus or Minus, Special Attack increases by 50%.
Plus.pokebase: Boosts the Sp. Atk stat of the Pokémon if an ally with the Plus or Minus Ability is also in battle.
Plus.smogon: If an active ally has this Ability or the Minus Ability, this Pokemon's Special Attack is multiplied by 1.5.

Poison Heal.text: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.
Poison Heal.serebii: HP is restored by 1/8th the maximum HP every turn while the Pokémon has the Poison condition.
Poison Heal.pokebase: If poisoned, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Poison Heal.smogon: If this Pokemon is poisoned, it restores 1/8 of its maximum HP, rounded down, at the end of each turn instead of losing HP.

Poison Point.text: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.
Poison Point.serebii: The opponent has a 30% chance of being induced with Poison when using an attack, that requires physical contact, against this Pokémon.
Poison Point.pokebase: Contact with the Pokémon may poison the attacker.
Poison Point.smogon: 30% chance a Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon will be poisoned.

Poison Touch.text: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.
Poison Touch.serebii: When the Pokémon attacks its opponents with a move that causes Physical Contact, there is a 30% chance that the target is Poisoned.
Poison Touch.pokebase: May poison a target when the Pokémon makes contact.
Poison Touch.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves have a 30% chance of poisoning. This effect comes after a move's inherent secondary effect chance.

Prankster.text: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.
Prankster.serebii: Status category moves have their Speed Priority increased by 1. Moves increased by this that are used on Dark-type opponents will fail.
Prankster.pokebase: Increases the priority of the Pokémon's status moves by 1 stage. However, the Pokémon's status moves no longer work against Dark-type Pokémon.
Prankster.smogon: This Pokemon's non-damaging moves have their priority increased by 1. Opposing Dark-type Pokemon are immune to these moves, and any move called by these moves, if the resulting user of the move has this Ability.

Pressure.text: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.
Pressure.serebii: When this Pokémon is hit by a move, the opponent’s PP lowers by 2 rather than 1.
Pressure.pokebase: Puts other Pokémon under pressure, causing them to expend more PP to use their moves.
Pressure.smogon: If this Pokemon is the target of an opposing Pokemon's move, that move loses one additional PP. Imprison, Snatch, and Tera Blast also lose one additional PP when used by an opposing Pokemon, but Sticky Web does not.

Protean.text: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.
Protean.serebii: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.
Protean.pokebase: Before the Pokémon uses a move, it becomes a pure Pokémon of that type. This only works once per switch in.
Protean.smogon: This Pokemon's type changes to match the type of the move it is about to use. This effect comes after all effects that change a move's type. This effect can only happen once per switch-in, and only if this Pokemon is not Terastallized.

Psychic Surge.text: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain, for 5 turns.
Psychic Surge.serebii: Activates Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Psychic Surge.pokebase: Turns the entire field into Psychic Terrain for 5 turns when the Pokémon enters a battle.
Psychic Surge.smogon: On switch-in, this Pokemon summons Psychic Terrain.

Punk Rock.text: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.
Punk Rock.serebii: Increases the damage of Sound based moves by 30%. Reduces damage taken by this Pokémon by Sound based moves by 50%.
Punk Rock.pokebase: Boosts the power of the Pokémon's sound-based moves by 30% and halves the damage the Pokémon takes from sound-based moves.
Punk Rock.smogon: This Pokemon's sound-based moves have their power multiplied by 1.3. This Pokemon takes halved damage from sound-based moves.

Pure Power.serebii: The Pokémon’s Attack stat is doubled in battle while having this ability.
Pure Power.pokebase: Using its pure power, the Pokémon doubles its Attack stat.

Purifying Salt.text: This Pokemon cannot become affected by a non-volatile status condition or Yawn. If a Pokemon uses a Ghost-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
Purifying Salt.serebii: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.
Purifying Salt.pokebase: The Pokémon's pure salt protects it from status conditions and halves the damage taken from Ghost-type moves.

Symbiosis.smogon: If an ally uses its item, this Pokemon gives its item to that ally immediately. Does not activate if the ally's item was stolen or knocked off, or if the ally used an Eject Button or Eject Pack.

Synchronize.text: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.
Synchronize.serebii: When this Pokémon becomes Poisoned, Paralyzed, or Burned, so does the opponent. However, Fire-type and Water Veil ability Pokémon cannot be Burned, Poison-type and Steel-type and Immunity ability Pokémon cannot be Poisoned, and Limber ability Pokémon cannot be Paralyzed.
Synchronize.pokebase: If the Pokémon is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned by another Pokémon, that Pokémon will be inflicted with the same status condition.
Synchronize.smogon: If another Pokemon burns, paralyzes, poisons, or badly poisons this Pokemon, that Pokemon receives the same non-volatile status condition.

Tangled Feet.text: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.
Tangled Feet.serebii: Pokémon’s evasion raises one level when Confused.
Tangled Feet.pokebase: Boosts the Pokémon's evasiveness if it is confused.
Tangled Feet.smogon: This Pokemon's evasiveness is doubled as long as it is confused.

Technician.text: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.
Technician.serebii: Moves with a base power of 60 or less are boosted in power by 50%
Technician.pokebase: Powers up weak moves so the Pokémon can deal more damage with them.
Technician.smogon: This Pokemon's moves of 60 power or less have their power multiplied by 1.5, including Struggle. This effect comes after a move's effect changes its own power.

Telepathy.text: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.
Telepathy.serebii: Prevents damage from team-mates during Double battles
Telepathy.pokebase: The Pokémon anticipates and dodges the attacks of its allies.
Telepathy.smogon: This Pokemon does not take damage from attacks made by its allies.

Thermal Exchange.text: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage after it is damaged by a Fire-type move. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
Thermal Exchange.serebii: Boosts the Attack stat when the Pokémon is hit by a Fire-type move. The Pokémon also cannot be burned.
Thermal Exchange.pokebase: When the Pokémon takes damage from a Fire-type move, its Attack stat is boosted by 1 stage. The Pokémon cannot be burned.
Thermal Exchange.smogon: This Pokemon's Attack is raised 1 stage after it is damaged by a Fire-type move. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Thick Fat.text: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.
Thick Fat.serebii: Fire and Ice-type moves deal 50% damage.
Thick Fat.pokebase: The Pokémon is protected by a layer of thick fat, which halves the damage taken from Fire- and Ice-type moves.
Thick Fat.smogon: If a Pokemon uses a Fire- or Ice-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon.

Torrent.text: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.
Torrent.serebii: When HP is below 1/3rd its maximum, power of Water-type moves is increased by 50%.
Torrent.pokebase: Powers up Water-type moves when the Pokémon's HP is low.
Torrent.smogon: When this Pokemon has 1/3 or less of its maximum HP, rounded down, its offensive stat is multiplied by 1.5 while using a Water-type attack.

Tough Claws.text: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.
Tough Claws.serebii: Increases the power of moves that make physical contact by 30%
Tough Claws.pokebase: Powers up moves that make direct contact.
Tough Claws.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves have their power multiplied by 1.3.

Toxic Debris.text: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.
Toxic Debris.serebii: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Toxic Debris.pokebase: Scatters poison spikes at the feet of the opposing team when the Pokémon takes damage from physical moves.
Toxic Debris.smogon: If this Pokemon is hit by a physical attack, Toxic Spikes are set on the opposing side.

Trace.text: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.
Trace.serebii: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.
Trace.pokebase: Ability becomes the same as that of the opponent. Switching this Pokémon out of battle restores its original ability. In a Double Battle, a random opponent’s ability will be copied.
Trace.smogon: On switch-in, this Pokemon copies a random opposing Pokemon's Ability. Abilities that cannot be copied are As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Flower Gift, Forecast, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Imposter, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Power of Alchemy, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, Receiver, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Teraform Zero, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Trace, Zen Mode, and Zero to Hero. If no opposing Pokemon has an Ability that can be copied, this Ability will activate as soon as one does.

Unaware.text: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.
Unaware.pokebase: When attacking, the Pokémon ignores the target's stat changes.
Unaware.smogon: This Pokemon ignores other Pokemon's Attack, Special Attack, and accuracy stat stages when taking damage, and ignores other Pokemon's Defense, Special Defense, and evasiveness stat stages when dealing damage.

Unburden.text: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.
Unburden.serebii: Speed is doubled once the held item is consumed.
Unburden.pokebase: Boosts the Speed stat if the Pokémon's held item is used or lost.
Unburden.smogon: If this Pokemon loses its held item for any reason, its Speed is doubled as long as it remains active, has this Ability, and is not holding an item.

Unnerve.text: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.
Unnerve.serebii: The opponent Pokémon will never use their held Berry while the Pokémon is in battle.
Unnerve.pokebase: Unnerves opposing Pokémon and makes them unable to eat Berries.
Unnerve.smogon: While this Pokemon is active, it prevents opposing Pokemon from using their Berries. This Ability activates before hazards and other Abilities take effect.

Unseen Fist.text: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.
Unseen Fist.serebii: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected. This damage is reduced to 25%
Unseen Fist.pokebase: The Pokémon can deal damage with moves that make physical contact, even if the target is protected.
Unseen Fist.smogon: This Pokemon's contact moves ignore a target's protection and deal 1/4 the usual damage.

Vital Spirit.text: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.
Vital Spirit.serebii: The Pokémon cannot be Asleep while having this ability.
Vital Spirit.pokebase: The Pokémon is full of vitality, and that prevents it from falling asleep.
Vital Spirit.smogon: This Pokemon cannot fall asleep. Gaining this Ability while asleep cures it.

Volt Absorb.text: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.
Volt Absorb.serebii: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Electric-type moves.
Volt Absorb.pokebase: If hit by an Electric-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Volt Absorb.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Electric-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by an Electric-type move.

Wandering Spirit.text: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.
Wandering Spirit.serebii: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Wandering Spirit.pokebase: The Pokémon exchanges Abilities with a Pokémon that hits it with a move that makes direct contact.
Wandering Spirit.smogon: Pokemon making contact with this Pokemon have their Ability swapped with this one. Does not affect Pokemon with the Abilities As One, Battle Bond, Comatose, Commander, Disguise, Embody Aspect, Hunger Switch, Ice Face, Illusion, Multitype, Neutralizing Gas, Poison Puppeteer, Power Construct, Protosynthesis, Quark Drive, RKS System, Schooling, Shields Down, Stance Change, Tera Shell, Tera Shift, Teraform Zero, Wonder Guard, Zen Mode, or Zero to Hero.

Water Absorb.text: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.
Water Absorb.serebii: The Pokémon heals up to 1/4 of its maximum Hit Points when hit with Water-type moves.
Water Absorb.pokebase: If hit by a Water-type move, the Pokémon has its HP restored instead of taking damage.
Water Absorb.smogon: This Pokemon is immune to Water-type moves and restores 1/4 of its maximum HP, rounded down, when hit by a Water-type move.

Water Bubble.text: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.
Water Bubble.serebii: Decreases Fire-type move power on the Pokémon by 50%. Increases power of Water-type moves used by the Pokémon by 100% before adding STAB. Prevents Burn
Water Bubble.pokebase: Lowers the power of Fire-type moves that hit the Pokémon and prevents it from being burned.
Water Bubble.smogon: This Pokemon's offensive stat is doubled while using a Water-type attack. If a Pokemon uses a Fire-type attack against this Pokemon, that Pokemon's offensive stat is halved when calculating the damage to this Pokemon. This Pokemon cannot be burned. Gaining this Ability while burned cures it.

Weak Armor.text: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.
Weak Armor.serebii: When hit by an attack, the Pokémon's Defense is lowered by one stage but Speed is increased by two stages.
Weak Armor.pokebase: The Pokémon's Defense stat is lowered when it takes damage from physical moves, but its Speed stat is sharply boosted.
Weak Armor.smogon: If a physical attack hits this Pokemon, its Defense is lowered by 1 stage and its Speed is raised by 2 stages.

White Smoke.text: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.
White Smoke.serebii: Opponents’ moves which lower this Pokémon’s stats have no effect. However this Pokémon may lower its own stats with its own moves.
White Smoke.pokebase: The Pokémon is protected by its white smoke, which prevents other Pokémon from lowering its stats.
White Smoke.smogon: Prevents other Pokemon from lowering this Pokemon's stat stages.

Zero to Hero.text: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
Zero to Hero.serebii: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
Zero to Hero.pokebase: The Pokémon transforms into its Hero Form when it switches out.
Zero to Hero.smogon: If this Pokemon is a Palafin in Zero Form, switching out has it change to Hero Form.
